v: Ayik mantalaj jun yol yib'anhk'inal tik, aytaxon ek' jun Slolonel Dios sb'i. Ha jun chi' aytaxon ek' yet' Dios, Dios ton wal.
Ayik manto sb'o jun yol yib'anhk'inal tik Dios, aytaxon ek' yet'ok.
A' yak'lab'ejnak Dios chi' ayik sb'o'annak masanil tastak. Malaj junok tas b'onak tato manh yujok.
Ha Slolonel Dios chi', aj k 'inal. Yuj jun k 'inal chi' ay sakil k'inal t'ayonh anima onh tik.
Ha jun sakil k'inal chi' tz'ak'an sakil k'inal b'aj ay k'ik' k'inal. Haxo jun k'ik' k'inal chi', max yal-laj yak'an tup jun sakil k'inal chi'.
Ay jun winh chekb'ilkot yuj Dios skuchan Juan.
Ulnakek' winh yak' testigo'al sb'a yuj jun sakil k'inal chi', yik wach' masanil mach tz'ak'anoch jun sakil k'inal chi' t'a sk'o'ol.
Manhoklaj winhaj Juan chi' aj sakil k'inal, tonhej ul yak'nak testigo'al sb'a winh yuj.
Ha jun yel sakil k'inal chi', wan sjawi t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. A' tz'ak'an sakil k'inal t'a masanil heb' anima.
Ha jun Slolonel Dios sb'i chi', ulnakek' t'a tik. Ha b'ojinak yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Palta ayik ix ulek'i, maj nachajel-laj yuj heb' anima tato ha'.
Ha t'a juntzanh heb' yiko', hata' ulnak ek'i, palta maj chajoklaj yuj heb' yik chi'.
Palta a jantaknhej heb' scha'ani, jantaknhej heb' tz'ak'anoch t'a sk'o'ol, a tz'alani to ay yalan yik heb' yoch yuninalok Dios.

Ayik tz'och heb' yuninalok Dios, ichato tz'aljixi heb'. Palta manh lajanok icha tz'aj yalji heb' anima. Manh anima'ok ay snib'ej tz'alji heb'. Manh yujok snib'ej junok winak, palta ha Dios tz'ak'anoch heb' yuninalok.

Ha jun Slolonel Dios sb'i chi', ochnak sniwanil icha kiko'. Ulnakek' kajan t'a ko kal. Ha jun chi' te yel. Niwan swach'k'olal Dios ul sch'oxnak t'ayonh. Kilnak wal sniwanil yelk'ochi, yujto anhej wal jun chi' Yuninal Dios, kotnak t'a Smam.

Ha winhaj Juan aljinakkan yab'ixal jun chi' icha tik: --Ay jun tzak'an sja wu'uj, palta ek'alto wal yelk'och yopisio t'a wichanh, yujto ayik manto in alji, aytaxon ek'i. Walnakxo yab'ixal t'ayex, xchi winh.
Ha jun chi', tz'akan yaj swach'k'olal, yuj chi' tz'akan sch'ox swach'k'olal chi' t'ayonh.
Ha winhaj Moisés ak'jinakkan sley Dios t'ayonh. Haxo Jesucristo sch'oxan swach'k'olal Dios t'ayonh, syak'an jun sk'ayb'ub'al te yel.
Malaj junok mach ix ilan Dios junelok. Palta a jun pitanh Yuninal, Dios ton paxi, a ul ch'oxjinakeli. Ha jun Yuninal tik junnhejtaxon yaj yet' Smam chi'.

Ha junel, ay juntzanh heb' israel aj Jerusalén, ix schekb'at jaywanh heb' sacerdote heb' yet' jaywanh heb' yinhtilal Leví. Ha t'a winhaj Juan ix k'och heb'. Ix sk'anb'an heb' t'a winh: --¿Mach ach? xchi heb'.
Ix yalan sjichanil winhaj Juan chi' t'a heb': --Ha in tik, manhok in Cristo in, xchi winh t'a heb'.
Ix sk'anb'an pax heb' t'a winh: --¿Mach ach jun? ¿Mato a ach Elías ach? xchi heb'. --Manhok in laj, xchi winh. --¿Mato a ach tik schekab' ach Dios tanhwab'il ku'uj? xchi heb'. --Ma'ay, xchi winh.
Ix sk'anb'anxi heb' t'a winh: --¿Mach ach pax jun? Al t'ayonh mach ach, yujto yowalil ol b'at kalxi yab' heb' onh chekankoti. Al t'ayonh tas aji, xchi heb'.

Yuj chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb': --Ha in tik tzin awaj t'a tzinan lu'um, swalan icha tik: Icha tz'aj sb'o b'e ayik sjawi junok yajal, icha chi' tzeyutej he b'o'an he b'eyb'al, yujto ol ja winh Kajal, xin chi. Yujto icha chi' yajkan stz'ib'aj wab'ixal yuj winhaj Isaías schekab' Dios t'a peka', xchi winh t'a heb'.
Ha juntzanh heb' xit'nak ek' t'a winhaj Juan chi', haton heb' winh fariseo chekannakb'at heb'.
Ix sk'anb'an pax heb' t'a winh: --¿Tas yuj tzak' bautizar heb' anima tato manh ach Cristooc, tato manh ach Elíasoc, tato manhok ach schekab' Dios tanhwab'il ku'uj? xchi heb' t'a winh.
--Ha in tik swak' bautizar heb' anima t'a ha ha'. Palta ay jun ayxo'ek' t'a ko kal tik manto eyojtakok.
Ha jun chi', tzak'an sja wu'uj, ek'al yopisio t'a wichanh. Manh in mojok wak'an serwil, wach'chom tonhej tzin tijel sch'anhal xanhab' t'a yok, xchi winhaj Juan chi' t'a heb'.
Ha t'a sk'axepal ha' Jordán, t'a jun lugar skuch Betania, hata' ix ak'ji bautizar heb' anima yuj winhaj Juan chi'. Hata' pax ix b'at sk'anb'ej juntzanh tik heb' t'a winh.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ix yilanb'at winhaj Juan to wan sk'och Jesús, ix yalan winh: --Ina'i, a yopisio jun wan sja tik, icha yopisio nok' kalnel, icha chi' yaj yopisio yuj Dios, yujto ha' ix jawi yik'kanel ko mul ko masanil t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Haton jun tik walnak: Ay jun tzak'an sja wu'uj, palta ek'al yopisio t'ayin, yujto ayik manto in alji, aytaxon ek'i, xin chi.
Max nachajel wu'uj mach jun chi', palta in ja wak' bautizar heb' anima t'a ha ha', yik wach' ol nachajel yuj heb' ketisraelal mach jun chi', xchi winhaj Juan chi'.
Ix yalanpax winh: --Ix wil yemul Yespíritu Dios t'a satcha'anh t'a yib'anh icha junok nok' paramuch, ix em t'a yib'anh, ix ochkan t'ay.

Max nachajel wu'uj, mach jun chi'. Palta a jun chekjinak in kot wak' bautizar heb' anima t'a ha ha', ha' ix halan t'ayin: Ol il yemul Wespíritu t'a yib'anh junok mach, ol ochkan t'ay. Ha jun chi' ol ak'anoch Espíritu Santo t'a heb' anima, ichato ol ak'jok bautizar heb' yuj, xchi Dios t'ayin.
Ha in tik ix wil jun chi'. Yuj chi' swak' testigo'al in b'a yuj to a Jesús tik, Yuninal ton Dios, xchi winh.
Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ayek' winhaj Juan yet' chawanh heb' winh sk'ayb'um.
Haxo ix yilanb'at winh, wan yek' Jesús ta'. Yuj chi' ix yal winh: --Ina'i, a jun tzek' chi', icha yopisio junok nok' kalnel, icha chi' yopisio yuj Dios, xchi winh.
Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' heb' winh sk'ayb'um winhaj Juan chi', ix och tzak'an heb' winh yuj Jesús.
Haxo ix meltzajb'at k'elan Jesús chi' t'a spatik. Ix yilani, tzak'anoch heb' winh yuj. --¿Tas tze saya'? xchi t'a heb' winh. --Ach ko k'ayb'umal ¿b'ajtil ay a posado? xchi heb' winh t'ay.

--Kotanhek, b'at kileknab'i b'aj ay in posado chi', xchi t'a heb' winh. Ix b'at heb' winh yet'ok, ix b'at yilan heb' winh b'aj ayek'i. Wanxo yem k'u ix b'at heb' winh, yuj chi' k'ik'b'alxo ix jax heb' winh.
Ix yab' chawanh heb' winh chi' tas ix yal winhaj Juan chi', yuj chi' ix och tzak'an heb' winh yuj Jesús. Ay jun winh skuch Andrés, yuk'tak sb'a winh yet' winhaj Simón Pedro.

Ixlajwi slolon winhaj Andrés chi' yet' Jesús chi', ix b'at sayan winh yuk'tak winh chi'. Haxo ix chax winh yuj winh, ix yalan winh: --Ix ilchaj winh Mesías ku'uj, xchi winh. (Mesías syalelk'ochi, Cristo, Ak'b'il Yopisio).

Junanto rato chi', ix yik'anb'at winh yuk'tak winh chi' t'a Jesús. Ix och k'elan Jesús t'a winhaj Simón, ix yalan t'a winh: --Simón, yuninal ach winhaj Juan. Cefas ol a b'i'ejkani, xchi t'a winh. (Cefas syalelk'ochi, Pedro, ma a k'e'en k'e'en.)
Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ix sna'an Jesús sb'at t'a yol yik Galilea. Ix ilchaj winhaj Felipe yuj. --Ochanh in k'ayb'umok, xchi t'a winh.
Ha winhaj Felipe chi', aj chonhab' Betsaida winh, haton schonhab' winhaj Andrés yet' winhaj Pedro.

Haxo winhaj Felipe chi' xit' sayankot winhaj Natanael. Haxo ix ilchaj winh yuj winh, ix yalan winh: --Ay jun ix ilchaj ku'uj. Haton jun chi' tz'ib'ab'ilkan yab'ixal yuj winhaj Moisés t'a ley, tz'ib'ab'ilpaxkan yuj heb' schekab' Dios t'a peka', haton Jesús, yuninal winhaj José aj chonhab' Nazaret, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Natanael chi': --¿Tom ay junok tas wach' syal skot t'a Nazaret chi'? xchi winh. --Kotanh, b'at kilnab'i, xchi winhaj Felipe chi'.
Haxo ix yilan Jesús to wan sk'och winhaj Natanael chi', ix yalani: --Ha jun winh sjawi tik, yel ton wal israel winh t'a yichanh Dios, malaj b'aj chab' sat syutej sb'a winh, xchi Jesús.

Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'an winhaj Natanael chi' t'ay: --¿Tas ix utej in ojtakaneli? xchi winh. --Ayik manto ach yawtejkot winhaj Felipe tik, toxo ix ach wila'. Ayach ek' t'a yich jun te' higo, xchi Jesús t'a winh.
--Ach in k'ayb'umal, yel Yuninal ach Dios. Ko Reyal ach a onh israel onh tik, xchi winh t'ay.
--¿Yujnhejto ix wala': Ix ach wil t'a yich jun te' higo, yuj chi' tzin ak'och t'a a k'o'ol? Palta ayto juntzanhxo ch'oxnab'il satub'tak ol ila', te niwan yelk'ochi, xchi t'a winh.

Ix yalanxi Jesús t'a heb' ayek' chi' yet'ok: --Wal yel swal t'ayex, ol heyila' to jakan spuerta'il satcha'anh. Haxo heb' yángel Dios ol eyil sk'e heb' yet' yemxul heb' t'ayin a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch anima'il tik, xchi Jesús.
Chab'jitax chi', ix och jun nupnajel t'a chonhab' Caná t'a yol yik Galilea. Ha ix snun Jesús, ayek' ix ta'.
Ix k'och pax Jesús yet' heb' sk'ayb'um, yujto awtab'il heb'.
Haxo wino, maj yab'laj, yuj chi' ix yal ix snun Jesús chi' t'ay: --Ixlajwi wino, xchi ix.
Palta ix yalan Jesús t'a ix: --Nunin, ¿tas yuj a t'ayin tzala'? Manto k'ochlaj yora'il in ch'oxanel in poder, xchi.
Haxo ix yalan ix snun chi' t'a heb' winh wan yak'an serwil chi': --Jantaknhej tas ol yal Jesús t'ayex, tze k'anab'ajejnhej, xchi ix t'a heb' winh.
Hata' ayek' wake' k'e'en k'e'en yet'tal ha ha'. Ay am otak ch'ub'ok ha ha' tz'em t'a yol junjun k'e'en. Ha yet' ha' sb'ikel juntzanh tastak heb', ichataxon smodo heb' israel chi'.
Ix yalan Jesús t'a heb' winh tz'ak'an serwil chi': --B'ut'ek juntzanh k'e'en yet'tal ha' tik, xchi t'a heb' winh. Haxo ix lajwi sb'ut'an k'e'en heb' winh,
ix yalanxi t'a heb' winh: --Ha tikne'ik, ik'ek k'eta jab'ok ha', ak'ek t'a winh stanhwan jun nupnajel tik, xchi t'a heb' winh. Yuj chi' ix yak'an heb' winh t'a winh chi'.

Haxo ix yab'lan jab' winh, toxo ix och ha' wino'al. Manh yojtakok winh b'ajtil ix kot jun wino chi'. Haxo heb' wan yak'an serwil chi', yojtakxo heb', yujto a heb' ix ik'ank'eta jun ha' chi'. Haxo winh ix awtankot winh wan snupnaj chi'.

Ix yalan winh t'a winh: --Ha smodo heb' anima, a wino wach', a syak' b'ab'laj uk'nax heb'. Haxo yik niwanxo ix laj yuk'ej heb' awtab'il chi', tz'ak'jipax jun wino ayxo wal syala'. Palta a ach tik, ix a sik'b'at jun wino wach'. Hato tikne'ik wan ak'anelta uk'naxok, xchi winh t'a winh.

Ix sch'ox jun milagro chi' Jesús t'a chonhab' Caná t'a yol yik Galilea. B'ab'el ch'oxnab'il satub'tak jun ix sch'ox chi'. Icha chi' ix yutej sch'oxani to niwan spoder. Haxo heb' sk'ayb'um, ix yak' wal och Jesús chi' heb' t'a sk'o'ol.
Ixlajwi chi', ix em Jesús t'a chonhab' Capernaum. Ajun pax ix snun yet'ok, heb' yuk'tak yet' pax heb' sk'ayb'um. Hata' ix ek' jaye' k'uhal heb'.
Wanxo sja sk'inh heb' israel yik snachajkot tas aj yelnakkot heb' t'a Egipto. Yuj chi' ix k'ex Jesús t'a chonhab' Jerusalén.
Hata' ix och t'a yol yamak'il stemplo Dios. Ix yilani, ay heb' chonhum wakax, ay heb' chonhum kalnel. Ay pax heb' chonhum paramuch. Ay pax juntzanhxo heb' k'exum tumin k'ojjab'ek'i.

Haxo ix yilan icha chi', ix sb'o'an jun ch'anh ch'anh smak'lab'ok. Ix spechanelta heb' smasanil t'a yol yamak'il templo chi' yet' nok' skalnel heb' yet' nok' swakax heb'. Ix laj tob'b'at juntzanh stumin heb' k'exum tumin chi' t'a sat lu'um, ix laj lokji pak'laj juntzanh smexa heb' yuj.
Ix yalan t'a heb' chonhum paramuch chi': --Ik'ekel juntzanh nok' tik. Ha stemplo in Mam tik, manh eyak'och mercado'al, xchi t'a heb'.
Ix sna'ankot heb' sk'ayb'um tas syal Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkan icha tik: Te pitz'anoch in k'o'ol t'a jun a templo tik, xchi.
Haxo heb' winh aj Judea ix halan t'ay: --¿Tas junok satub'tak tza ch'ox t'ayonh, yik snachajel ku'uj to ay halan ik a k'ulan juntzanh tik? xchi heb' winh t'ay.
Yuj chi' ix yalan t'a heb' winh: --Pojekel jun stemplo Dios tik, haxo t'a schab'ji'al ol in b'o'anxik'e'i, xchi t'a heb' winh.
Yuj chi', ix yalanxi heb' winh aj Judea chi' t'ay: --Ha jun stemplo Dios tik, 46 ab'ilxo skajwi sb'o'i. Ha hachxo tik, ¿tom ol b'o u'uj t'a oxe' k'uhal chi'? xchi heb' winh t'ay.
Ha stemplo Dios chi' ix yal sna'an heb' winh, palta a sniwanil ix yala'.

Yuj chi', hato yik ix pitzwixi t'a skal heb' chamnak, ix sna'ankot heb' sk'ayb'um tas ix yala'. Ix yak'anoch heb' t'a sk'o'ol tas tz'ib'yajkan t'a Slolonel Dios yet' tas yalnakkan Jesús chi' t'a heb'.
Ayik ayek' Jesús t'a Jerusalén yuj sk'inh heb' israel yik snachajkot tas aj yelnakkot heb' t'a Egipto, tzijtum heb' ix ak'anoch Jesús t'a sk'o'ol, yujto ix yil juntzanh satub'tak heb' ix sch'oxo'.
Ha Jesús maj yak'ochlaj heb' yipok sk'o'ol, yujto yojtak spensar masanil heb' anima.
Manh yowalilok tz'alji t'ay tas ko pensar junjun onh, toxonton yojtak tas sko na'a.
Ay jun winh fariseo skuch Nicodemo, yajal yaj winh t'a skal heb' yetyajalil t'a Judea.

Ix k'och winh t'a Jesús t'ak'walil, ix yalan winh t'ay icha tik: --Ach ko k'ayb'umal, kojtak to ha Dios chekjinak ach kot onh a k'ayb'ej, yujto ay juntzanh satub'tak tza ch'oxo'. Malaj junok mach syal sk'ulan juntzanh chi', tato manh ayok och Dios yet'ok, xchi winh t'ay.
Ix yalan Jesús t'a winh: --Wal yel swal t'ayach, a mach max aljixi t'a scha'elal, manh ol yal-laj yoch t'a yol sk'ab' Dios, xchi t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'an winhaj Nicodemo chi': --Ha junok icham animaxo, ¿tasto ol yutok yaljixi t'a scha'elal? ¿Tom tzato yal yoch t'a yol sk'ol snun yik tz'aljixi? xchi winh.
Ix yalanxi Jesús chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Wal yel swal t'ayach, a mach max alji t'a ha ha' yet' pax yuj Yespíritu Dios, manh ol yal-laj yoch t'a yol sk'ab' Dios.
Ha heb' tz'alji t'a snun, animanhej heb'. Palta haxo heb' tz'alji pax yuj Yespíritu Dios, espíritu ton heb'.
Manh ak' sat a k'o'ol yuj tas swal tik, yowalil tzex aljixi t'a scha'elal.
Ha ik' yalxonhej b'aj sb'ati. Skab' sk'anhi, palta malaj mach ojtannak b'aj skoti yet' b'aj sk'ochi. Icha jun ik' chi', icha chi' yaj heb' tz'alji yuj Yespíritu Dios, xchi Jesús t'a winh.
Ix sk'anb'anxi winh: --¿Tas syalelk'och jun tik? xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalanxi Jesús: --¿Tom max nachajel juntzanh swal tik u'uj? Ina te k'ayb'um ach t'a skal heb' ketisraelal.
Wal yel swal t'ayach, a tas kojtak, a skala'. Ha tas skila', a skala'. Palta max he cha eyab' tas swal t'ayex.
Tato max he cha eyab' tas swal t'ayex yuj tastak ay t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ¿tom hato tas ay t'a satcha'anh ol he cha eyab'i?
Malaj junok mach ix xit'k'e t'a satcha'anh. Palta a in tik, hata' kotnak in, yujto Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch anima'il, aj satcha'anh in.
Icha yutejnak winhaj Moisés st'unhb'ank'e jun k'e'en yechel chan t'a takinh lu'um, icha chi' ol in ajk'e t'unhan.
Icha chi' ol in ajok, yik wach' a jantaknhej heb' tzin ak'anoch t'a sk'o'ol, manh ol satel heb', palta to ol scha sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej.

Yujto te xajan heb' anima t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik yuj Dios, yuj chi' wach'chom a innhej Yuninal in, palta in yak'koti yik wach' a heb' tzin ak'anoch t'a sk'o'ol, manh ol satel-laj heb', palta ay sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej.
Ha in tik, Yuninal in ton Dios. Manh yujok wak'an syahelal heb' anima in ak'jikot t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, palta yuj ul in kolankanel heb'.

Ha heb' tzin ak'anoch t'a sk'o'ol, manh ol b'atkan heb' t'a syahelal. Haxo heb' max in ak'anoch t'a sk'o'ol jun, ayxokot syahelal heb' t'a yib'anh, yujto a innhej Yuninal in Dios, palta max in yak'och heb' t'a sk'o'ol.

Ha in tik in emul t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik yik swak' sakil k'inal t'a heb' anima. Palta ay pax heb' malaj snib'ej t'a jun sakil k'inal tik. Yuj chi', ol kannhej syahelal heb' t'a yib'anh. Anhej wal yik k'ik' k'inal snib'ej heb', yujto anhej chukal sk'ulej heb'.
Jantaknhej heb' sk'ulan chukal, malaj tz'och jun sakil k'inal tik t'a heb'. Malaj snib'ej heb' scha'ani, yujto xiw heb' scheklajelta juntzanh chukal sk'ulej chi'.
Palta a heb' sk'anab'ajan jun k'ayb'ub'al te yel, scha jun sakil k'inal tik heb', yik wach' scheklajeli to ayoch Dios yet' heb' t'a tas sk'ulej, xchi Jesús t'a winhaj Nicodemo chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at Jesús yet' heb' sk'ayb'um t'a yol yik Judea. Hata' ix ek' jaye' k'uhal yet' heb'. Ix yak'an bautizar heb' anima ta'.
Hanhejtona' ix yak'pax bautizar heb' anima winhaj Juan t'a jun lugar skuch Enón, t'a slak'anil Salim, yujto manh jantakok ha ha' ta'. Ix laj k'och heb' anima, ix yak'an bautizar sb'a heb' t'a winh.
Ayik manto ak'ji'och winhaj Juan chi' t'a preso, ix sk'ulan juntzanh chi' winh.
Ay jaywanh heb' sk'ayb'um winhaj Juan chi' ix stelaj sb'a yet' jun winh aj Judea yuj tas syutej sb'o'an sb'a heb' anima icha yalan ley.

Yuj chi', xit' yalan heb' t'a winhaj Juan chi': --Ach ko k'ayb'umal, a jun ek'nak het'ok t'a sk'axepal ha' Jordán, jun alnakkan t'ayonh, a jun chi' wan yak'an bautizar heb' anima tikne'ik. Ix laj och heb' sk'ayb'umok, xchi heb' t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalan winh t'a heb': --Malaj junok mach syal skomon och yopisio tato manhok Dios tz'ak'an t'ay.
Ha ex tik, eyab'nak walani to manh in Cristooc. Ha in ton tik b'ab'laj chekb'il in kot t'a yichanh Cristo chi'.

K'inalok ay junok nupnajel tz'och tikne'ik, a winh wan snupnaj chi', a winh tz'ik'an ix ix chi'. Ha jun yamigo winh snupnaj chi', ayik syab'an yawaj winh snupnaj chi', ste tzalaji. Icha chi' in tzalaj tikne'ik, yujto wan yoch heb' anima sk'ayb'umok Jesús.
Ha Cristo chi', yowalil ol te k'ib'nhej yopisio chi'. Ha inxo tik, yowalil k'ojank'olal ol satxi'em wopisio tik, xchi winh t'a heb'.

--Ha jun emnakkot t'a satcha'anh chi', ek'to yopisio t'a smasanil anima. Ha onhxo ayonh t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, anima onnhej ko masanil. Anhej wal yik yol yib'anhk'inal tik skala'. Palta haxo jun emnakkot t'a satcha'anh chi', ek'to yopisio t'ayonh ko masanil.
Ha tas yab'nak yet' tas yilnak, a syala', palta malaj mach scha'an yab' t'ay.
Tato ay heb' scha'an yab' t'ay, sch'oxel heb' to yel syal Dios.
Yujto a jun chi', ha Dios ix chekankoti. Yuj chi' a slolonel Dios syala'. Tz'akan yajoch Yespíritu Dios t'ay.
Ha Yuninal ko Mam Dios, te xajan yuj. Yuj chi', a Smam chi' ix ak'anoch masanil tastak t'a yol sk'ab'.

Ha heb' tz'ak'anoch Yuninal Dios t'a sk'o'ol, ayxo sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej. Haxo heb' malaj snib'ej yak'anoch t'a sk'o'ol jun, manh ol schalaj sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej, palta aykot yowal sk'ol Dios t'a yib'anh heb'.
Haxo ix yab'an heb' fariseo to a heb' sk'ayb'um Jesús ix te ek' sb'isul heb' t'a yichanh heb' sk'ayb'um winhaj Juan, ek'to pax heb' tz'ak'ji bautizar yuj.
Palta manhoklaj Jesús chi' tz'ak'an bautizar heb', a heb' sk'ayb'um.
Ayik ix yab'an Jesús to yojtak jun chi' heb' fariseo chi', ix el t'a yol yik Judea, ix b'atxi t'a Galilea.
Yowalil ha t'a yol yik Samaria tz'ek'i ayik smeltzaji.
Yuj chi' ayik wan yek' t'a yol yik Samaria chi', ix k'och t'a chonhab' Sicar. Ha jun chonhab' chi', ha t'a slak'anil jun lum lum yak'nakkan winhaj Jacob t'a jun yuninal skuch José, hata' ay.
Hata' ay jun sjaj ha ha' joyb'ilkan yuj winhaj Jacob chi'. Haxo Jesús chi', chimk'uhalil ix k'och ta'. Yujto ix k'unb'i sb'eyi, yuj chi' ix k'ojnaj t'a sti' jun ha' chi'.

Haxo heb' sk'ayb'um, ix b'at heb' sman yik schimk'uhalil t'a jun chonhab' ay t'a slak'anil ha' chi'. Ayik toxo ix b'at heb', ix k'och jun ix ti'awum aj Samaria. Ix yalan Jesús t'a ix: --Ak' jab'ok ha' tik wuk'ej, xchi t'a ix.

Ix yalan ix: --Ha ach tik, israel ach. ¿Tas yuj tza k'an ha' uk' t'ayin? ¿Tom manh ojtakok to aj Samaria in? xchi ix t'ay. Icha chi' ix yutej ix yalani, yujto a heb' israel yet' heb' aj Samaria chi', max sk'umejlaj sb'a heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalanxi Jesús t'a ix: --Tzin k'an wuk' jab'ok ha' t'ayach, palta manh ojtakok mach in. Manh ojtakok paxi tas snib'ej Dios syak' t'ayach. Oktom wal ojtak, a ach am tza k'an t'ayin, a inxo swak' jun ha ha' tz'ak'an a k 'inal, xchi Jesús t'a ix.
--Mamin, ina malaj junok a lechlab' b'aj syal ik'ank'eta ha'. Te jul yajem ha'. ¿B'ajtil ol ik' jun ha ha' ol ak'an in k 'inal chi'?

Joyb'ilkan sjaj ha ha' tik yuj winh ko mam kicham aj Jacob. Ha winh uk'jinak ha' yet' heb' yuninal t'a tik yet' masanil nok' smolb'etzal nok'. Chamnak winh, skannak jun ha' tik t'ayonh. Ha hachxo tik ¿tom ek'al opisio t'a winhaj Jacob chi'? xchi ix t'ay.
Yuj chi' ix yalan t'a ix: --Ha mach tz'uk'an jun ha ha' tik, stakjixi sti' heb'.

Palta haxo heb' tz'uk'an jun ha' swak'a', manhxa b'ak'inh ol takjokxi sti' heb', yujto a jun ha' swak' chi', ol aj sjaj ha' t'a spixan heb', haxo ha' ol ak'an sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej, xchi Jesús t'a ix.
Ix yalanxi ix: --Mamin, ak' jun ha ha' chi' t'ayin, yik manhxo ol takjok in ti', yik pax manhxo yowalilok ol ul wik'k'eta jun ha' tik, xchi ix.
Ix yalanxi t'a ix: --Ixik, ix ik'kot winh etb'eyum, tzex ja t'a tik, xchi Jesús t'a ix.
--Malaj winh wetb'eyum, xchi ix. --Telan, yel ton tzala' malaj winh etb'eyum tikne'ik.
Palta owanhxo heb' winh b'aj xit'nak ach. Haxo winh b'aj ay ach ek' tikne'ik, manh etb'eyumok ton winh. Yuj chi' yelton tzala': Malaj winh wetb'eyum xa chi, xchi Jesús t'a ix.
Ayik ix lajwi yab'an juntzanh chi' ix, ix yalanxi ix: --Mamin, a swutej wab'ani to schekab' ach Dios.

Ha heb' ko mam kicham a onh aj Samaria onh tik, ha t'a jun witz tik yalnak sb'a heb' t'a Dios. Palta a exxo israel ex tik, tzeyala': Ha t'a Jerusalén, hata' yowalil b'at kal ko b'a t'a Dios, xe chi, xchi ix.

Ix yalanxi Jesús t'a ix: --Ach ix, ak'och t'a a k'o'ol tas swala'. Ay jun pekti' ol jawok, manhxo'oklaj t'a jun witz tik ol ul eyal he b'a t'a ko Mam Dios. Hanhejtona' t'a Jerusalén, manhxo yowalilok ol ex k'och eyal he b'a ta'.
Ha ex aj Samaria ex tik, niwanok tzeyal he b'a t'a Dios, palta manh eyojtakoklaj. Xal onh israel onh tik, kojtak ko Diosal b'aj skal ko b'a. Ha t'a ko kal ol elta jun Kolwajum.

Ay heb' to t'a ko Mam Dios syal sb'a icha wal t'a smojal. Haxo tikne'ik, toxo ix ja stiempo'al, ol yal sb'a heb' t'a Dios kuchb'ab'il heb' yuj Espíritu icha wal t'a smojal, yujto a ko Mam Dios, snib'ej icha chi' tz'aj yalan sb'a heb' t'ay.
Ha Dios, Espíritu. Yuj chi', tato ay heb' syal sb'a t'ay, yowalil a Espíritu skuchb'an heb' icha wal t'a smojal, xchi Jesús t'a ix.
Ix yalanxi ix t'ay: --Ha in tik, wojtak to ol ja jun Mesías. Ayik ol jawok ol yalan masanil tastak t'ayonh, xchi ix t'ay. (Mesías syalelk'ochi Cristo, Ak'b'il Yopisio.)
--Ha in ton wan walan tik t'ayach, xchi Jesús t'a ix.

Ha wal slajwi yalan juntzanh chi' Jesús ix jax heb' sk'ayb'um. Ix sat sk'o'ol heb' yilani to wan slolon Jesús yet' jun ix ix. Palta malaj junok heb' ix k'anb'an t'ay tas sk'anb'ej t'a ix, ma tas yuj slolon yet' ix.
Ix yaktejkan sch'ub' ix t'a sti' ha ha' chi'. Ix b'at yalan ix t'a heb' anima ay t'a schonhab'. Ix yalan ix t'a heb':
--Ay jun winh masanil tas ojtannak yiktax in kotoch uninal. Ix yal winh t'ayin smasanil. Koyek wet'ok, b'at kileknab'i. ¿Tope alaj winh Cristo? xchi ix t'a heb'.
Yuj chi' ix elta heb' t'a yol schonhab' chi'. Ix jawi heb' b'aj ayek' Jesús.
Ayik manto k'och heb', ix yalan heb' sk'ayb'um Jesús chi' t'ay: --Ach ko k'ayb'umal, wa'anh jab'ok, xchi heb'.
Palta ix yalan t'a heb': --Ay jun in wa'el manh eyojtakok a ex tik, xchi t'a heb'.
Yuj chi' ix laj sk'anb'an heb' t'ay junjun: --¿Tom ay mach ix ul ak'an wa'ok? xchi heb'.
Palta ix yalanxi t'a heb': --Ayik tzin k'ulan tas snib'ej jun in chekankoti, yik syik'an sb'a smunlajel, ichato tzin wa swab'i.

Ha ex tik tzeyala': Chanheto ujal sja stiempo'al sjochchaj ixim trigo, xe chi. Palta a in swal t'ayex: K'e'anhek k'elan, ileknab'i, toxo ix k'och sk'uhal smolchajkot heb' anima t'ayin icha tz'aj sjochchaj ixim trigo.

Ay mach wan scha'an stojol yuj smolb'ankot heb' anima t'ayin yik scha'an sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej icha yaj heb' jochum trigo. Yuj chi' a mach tz'alanel Slolonel Dios icha tz'aj stzikjib'at ixim trigo yet' heb' smolb'ankot heb' anima icha tz'aj sjochchaj ixim, junnhej ol tzalaj heb'.
Yujto yel syal jun ab'ix tik: Jun stzikanb'ati, ch'okxo mach sjochani, xchi.

Ha in tik, ix ex in chekb'at munlajel t'a skal heb' anima icha heb' sjochwi trigo, maj eyab' sya'il he tzikanb'ati. Ch'ok heb' b'ab'laj munlajnak t'a skal heb' icha heb' tzikumb'at trigo chi'. Ha exxo tik, toxonhej tze jochk'e wa'an ixim trigo chi', xchi Jesús t'a heb' sk'ayb'um chi'.

Ha t'a jun chonhab' t'a yol yik Samaria chi', tzijtum heb' ix ak'anoch Jesús t'a sk'o'ol, yujto a jun ix ix chi' ix halan t'a skal heb': Yojtaknhej tastak tzin k'ulej yiktax in kotoch uninal, xchi ix.
Ix jawi heb', ix tewi'och heb' t'a Jesús to skan yet' heb'. Yuj chi' chab' k'uhal ix ek' yet' heb'.
Tzijtumto heb' ix ak'anoch t'a sk'o'ol ayik ix yab'an heb' tas ix yala'.

Yuj chi' ix yal heb' t'a ix ix chi': --Ha tikne'ik skak'och t'a ko k'o'ol, manhoknhej yuj tas ix al chi' t'ayonh, yujto skab' wal yet' ko chikin. Skojtakan wal el sik'lab'il to t'a wal yel a jun tik ko Kolumal yaj t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, xchi heb' t'a ix.
Ayik ix ek' chab' k'uhal chi', ix helxi Jesús t'a Samaria, ix b'atxi t'a yol yik Galilea,
yujto yalnak Jesús to malaj yelk'och junok schekab' Dios t'a heb' anima b'aj kajan.

Ayik ix k'ochxi t'a Galilea, ix te tzalaj heb' anima scha'an sk'ochi, yujto ayik ix xit'ek' heb' t'a Jerusalén t'a jun sk'inh heb' israel yik sna'ankot heb' tas aj yelnakkot heb' t'a Egipto, ix yil heb' juntzanh tastak xit' sk'ulej Jesús chi' ta'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix k'ochxi Jesús chi' t'a chonhab' Caná t'a yol yik Galilea, haton b'aj ochnak ha ha' wino'al yuj. Haxo t'a chonhab' Capernaum ay jun winh yajal yaj t'a winh rey, ay jun yuninal winh te pena'ay.

Ayik ix yab'an winh to ix kotxi Jesús t'a Judea, ix jaxxi t'a Galilea, ix b'at winh yil Jesús. Ix tewi winh t'ay yik sb'at yet' winh t'a spat, yik sb'at yak'an b'oxok sk'o'ol jun yuninal winh chi', yujto wanxo schami.
Ix yalan Jesús t'a winh: --Tato max eyil juntzanh satub'tak tzin ch'oxo', juntzanh sch'oxanel in poder, tekan malaj junok ex tzin eyak'och t'a he k'o'ol, xchi.
Palta ix yalanxi winh yajal chi': --Mamin, konh wet' elanhchamel, yakb'an manto cham jun wuninal chi', xchi winh t'ay.
Ix yalanxi Jesús icha tik: --Paxanh. Manh ol chamlaj jun uninal chi', xchi t'a winh. Ix yak'anoch winh t'a sk'o'ol tas ix yal Jesús chi', yuj chi' ix pax winh.
Wanto sk'ochxi winh t'a spat, haxo heb' schekab' winh ix elta scha'a. Ix yalan heb': --Pitzan winh uninal chi', xchi heb' t'a winh.
Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb': --¿Janik' ix b'oxi sk'o'ol winh jun? xchi winh. --Atax t'a ewi t'a tz'eymaj k'uhal sikb'i jun k'ak' chi' t'a winh, xchi heb'.
Yuj chi' ix sna'ankot winh to icha chi' yora'il yal Jesús chi' t'a winh icha tik: Manh ol chamlaj jun uninal chi', xchi. Yuj chi', ix yak'och Jesús winh t'a sk'o'ol yet' jantak heb' ay t'a yol spat.
Haton jun schab'il yechel satub'tak sch'ox Jesús tik. Ayik spetoj t'a Judea ix k'ochxi t'a Galilea, hata' ix sb'o junxo tik.
Ixlajwi chi' ix k'exxi Jesús t'a Jerusalén, ix b'at yilan jun sk'inh heb' yetisraelal.
Ha t'a yol chonhab' Jerusalén chi', t'a slak'anil jun puerta b'aj tz'och nok' kalnel, hata' ay jun tanque skuch Betesda t'a sti' heb' israel chi'. Oye' wal stenta'il.
Tzijtum heb' pena'ay ayek' ta. Ay heb' max yal yilani, ay heb' max yal sb'eyi, ay heb' sikb'inakeli.
Ay jun winh 38 ab'ilxo pena'ay.
Haxo ix yilan Jesús jichanek' winh. Yojtak to pekatax icha chi' yaj winh. Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'an t'a winh: --¿Tzam a nib'ej tzach b'oxikani? xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalan winh pena'ay chi': --Mamin, malaj mach tzin ak'anem t'a yol ha' tik ayik tz'ib'xi ha' t'a juntak el. Ayik tzin nib'ej tzin emi, ch'okxo heb' sb'ab'laj em t'a wichanh, xchi winh t'a Jesús.
Yuj chi' ix yalan Jesús t'a winh: --K'e'anh wa'an, ik'cha'anh a waynub' tik, b'eyanh, xchi t'a winh.
T'a jun rato chi', ix b'oxi sk'o'ol winh. Ix yik'ancha'anh swaynub' winh chi', ix syamanoch winh sb'eyi. Palta sk'uhal ik'oj ip.
Yuj chi' ay jaywanh heb' aj Judea ix halan t'a winh: --Ha tikne'ik, sk'uhal ik'oj ip. Manh sleyalok tzik'cha'anh a waynub' tik, xchi heb' t'a winh.
Ix tak'wi winh t'a heb' icha tik: --Ha jun winh in ak'an b'oxok, a winh ix halan t'ayin: Ik'chanh a waynub' tik, tzach b'eyi, xchi winh, xchi winh.
Ix sk'anb'an heb' t'a winh: --¿Mach jun winh ix halan chi' t'ayach to tzik'cha'anh a waynub' tik, tzach b'eyi? xchi heb'.
Palta manh yojtakok winh tas sb'i jun ix ak'an b'oxok sk'o'ol winh chi', yujto ix satb'at Jesús chi' t'a skal jantak anima ayek' chi' ta'.

Haxo t'a junelxo ix ilchaj winh yuj Jesús t'a yamak'il stemplo Dios, ix yalan t'a winh: --Ina'i ach b'oxi. Manhxo a k'ulej chukal, yik manhxo ol ja junokxo yahelal más te niwan t'a ib'anh, xchi t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winh yal t'a heb' winh aj Judea chi' to a Jesús chi' ix ak'an b'oxok sk'o'ol winh.
Yuj chi' ix te och heb' winh ajk'olal t'a Jesús chi', yujto ha t'a sk'uhal ik'oj ip ix sk'ulej juntzanh chi'.
Palta ix yalan Jesús t'a heb': --Ha in Mam smunlajnhej. Yuj chi' hanheja' tzin munlajnhejpaxi, xchi t'a heb'.
Yujto ix yal juntzanh chi' Jesús, ijanxo wal snib'ej heb' smilchamok. Manhoknhej yuj b'aj max sk'anab'ajej sk'uhal ik'oj ip chi', palta yujto slajb'ej sb'a yet' Dios ayik syalanoch Dios chi' Smamok.

Ix yalanxi Jesús t'a heb': --Wal yel swal t'ayex, a in tik Yuninal in Dios, max yal in k'ulan junok tas t'a yol wiko', anhej tas swil sk'ulan in Mam tzin k'ulej. Ha jantaknhej tas sk'ulej in Mam chi', a tzin k'ulejpaxi.
Ha in Mam chi', te xajan in yuj a in Yuninal in tik. Ha jantaknhej tas sk'ulej, sch'oxpax t'ayin. Ayto wal juntzanhxo tas te niwan ol sch'oxo', ol te sat he k'o'ol heyilani.
Yujto a in Mam chi' tz'ak'an pax pitzwok heb' chamnak, syak'an sk'inal heb'. Ichinpaxta' a in Yuninal in tik swak' sk'inal heb' in gana swak' sk'inal.
Ha in Mam chi', max sch'olb'itej junok anima. Palta a in Yuninal in tik, ix ak'ji wopisio in ch'olb'itan yaj heb' anima smasanil,
yik wach' lajan tz'aj wik'jicha'anh icha tz'aj yik'jicha'anh in Mam chi' yuj masanil anima. Tato ay heb' malaj tzin och t'ay, hanhejtona' malaj tz'ochpax in Mam t'a heb', yujto a chekjinak in koti.

Wal yel swal t'ayex, a heb' tz'ab'an in lolonel, syak'anpaxoch jun in chekankot heb' t'a sk'o'ol, ay sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej. Manhxo ol b'atkan heb' t'a syahelal, yujto toxo ix kolchajel heb' t'a yol sk'ab' chamel, ix scha'an sk'inal heb'.
Wal yel swal t'ayex, a tikne'ik toxo ix ja stiempo'al yab'an in jaj heb' chamnak a in Yuninal in Dios tik. Ha heb' tz'ab'ani, ol scha sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej.
Yujto a in Mam aj k'inaltaxon t'a yol yiko'. Yak'annakkan jun chi' t'ayin to aj k 'inal in paxi.
Yak'annakpaxkan wopisio in ch'olb'itan masanil heb' anima, yujto Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch anima'il.
Manh eyak' sat he k'ol yuj juntzanh swal tik, yujto ay jun pekti' ol jawok, a wal heb' mukanxo ol yab' in jaj heb'.

Ol laj k'ex wa'an heb' b'aj mukan chi'. Ha heb' wach' syutej sb'a t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ol pitzwokxi heb', ol scha'an sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej. Haxo heb' sk'ulan chukal, ol pitzwokxi heb', palta ol b'atkan heb' t'a syahelal t'a junelnhej.

Ha in tik, malaj jab'ok tas syal in b'o'an t'a yol wiko', tzin ch'olb'itej icha tas schek in Mam chi' in k'ulej. Tzin ch'olb'itej t'a stojolal, yujto manhok tas icha in gana tzin k'ulej, palta icha snib'ej jun chekjinak in koti, haton in Mam.
Tato munil swala' to ay wopisio, malaj yelk'och jun wik swal chi'.
Palta ay junxo tz'alani tas wopisio. Ha jun chi', wojtak to te yel syala'.
Ha ex tik xit' he chek k'anb'aj t'a winhaj Juan tas yopisio winh. Ha tas yalnak winh wu'uj, te yel.
Palta a in tik, max wak'ochlaj yipok in k'o'ol tas syal junok anima wu'uj. Tonhej swek he nakoti tas yalnakkan winhaj Juan chi' t'ayex, yik tzex kolchaji.
Ha tas ix yal winhaj Juan chi', lajan icha junok tas tz'ak'an sakil k'inal ayel yok. Yuj chi', ix ex te tzalaj jaye'ok k'uhal eyab'ani.

Palta ay junxo ek'al yelk'och t'a winhaj Juan chi'. Ha sch'oxaneli tas wopisio, yujto a juntzanh tas syak' in Mam in k'ulej, a tzin k'ulej. Icha chi' tz'aj scheklajeli to a in Mam chi' chekjinak in koti.
Ha in Mam chi', a chekjinak in koti, a syak' testigo'al sb'a wu'uj. Ha ex tik, malaj b'aj ix eyab' sjaj sloloni. Malaj b'aj ix eyil junelok.
Max eyak'och slolonel t'a he k'o'ol, yujto max in eyak'och t'a he k'o'ol a in chekb'il in kot yuj tik.
Ha ex tik scham wal he sayan eyil t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani, yujto a he na'ani to icha chi' ol aj yilchaj he k 'inal t'a junelnhej. Palta wach'chom syal wab'ixal Slolonel Dios chi',
malaj he gana tzex ja t'ayin yik tze cha he k 'inal.
Malaj yelk'och t'ayin tato syal wach' lolonel heb' anima wu'uj.
Wojtak tas yaj he pensar, manh xajanok Dios eyu'uj.
Ha in tik, ak'b'il in kot yuj in Mam, palta max in he cha'a. Tato ay junokxo munil ol jawok t'a yol yiko', a jun chi' ol he cha'a.
¿Tas ol aj in eyak'anoch t'a he k'o'ol, yujto anhej t'a eyichanh junjun ex he gana ay eyelk'ochi, malaj pax he gana ay eyelk'och t'a yichanh Dios te yel?
Xe natalaj to a in ol wal t'a in Mam chi' tas he chukal. Palta a winhaj Moisés ol alanok, haton winh tze tz'ak eyak'och t'a he k'o'ol.
Tato tzeyak'och t'a he k'o'ol tas stz'ib'ejnakkan winhaj Moisés chi', tzam in eyak'ochlaj t'a he k'o'ol, yujto a winhaj Moisés chi' tz'ib'annakkan wab'ixal.
Palta tato max eyak'och tas stz'ib'ejnakkan winh chi' t'a he k'o'ol, ¿tas ol aj eyak'anoch t'a he k'o'ol tas swal tik t'ayex? xchi Jesús t'a heb' winh aj Judea chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'atxi Jesús, ix k'ochxi t'a junxo sk'axepalek' ha' nhajab' yik Galilea, skuchan pax ha' Tiberias.
Tzijtum heb' anima ix och tzak'an yuj, yujto ix yil juntzanh satub'tak sch'ox yil heb' ayik syak'an b'oxok sk'ol heb' pena'ay.
Haxo Jesús chi', ix b'at yet' heb' sk'ayb'um t'a jun tzalan. Hata' ix em k'ojan yet' heb'.
Wanxo sja stiempo'al sk'inh heb' israel yik snajikot tas aj yelnakkot heb' smam yicham heb' t'a Egipto.
Haxo ix yilan Jesús, tzijtum heb' anima wan sk'och t'ay. Yuj chi' ix yalan t'a winhaj Felipe: --¿B'ajtil ol ko man tas swa heb' anima tik? xchi t'a winh.
Palta tonhej ix yal icha chi', yik syab'i tas ol yal winhaj Felipe chi', yujto yojtakxo tas ol yutok.
Ix yalan winhaj Felipe chi' t'ay: --Wach'chom ket'nak chab'ok ciento denario pan, palta max yab'laj yik tz'ak'chaj jab' jab'ok t'a junjun heb', xchi winh.
Ay pax junxo sk'ayb'um Jesús, skuch Andrés, yuk'tak sb'a winh yet' winhaj Simón Pedro. Ix yalan winh t'a Jesús chi':
--Ay jun winh unin ayek' ket' t'a tik, yet'nak oye' ixim pan cebada winh yet' cha pitanh nok' chay. Palta ¿tom ol yab' jab' tik t'a skal heb' smasanil? Ina te tzijtum heb', xchi winh.

Yuj chi', ix yalan Jesús t'a heb' sk'ayb'um chi': --Alek t'a heb' anima tik to tz'em k'ojan heb' smasanil, xchi t'a heb'. Ha jun lugar b'aj ayek' heb' chi', niwan ak'lik. Ix em k'ojan heb' smasanil, ay am oye'ok mil heb' winh winak.

Haxo Jesús ix ik'ancha'anh ixim pan chi', ix yak'an yuj diosal t'a Dios yuj ixim. Ix schekan pukjokb'at ixim t'a heb' k'ojanem chi'. Icha pax chi' ix yutej nok' chay chi'. Ix yab'lej heb', hato syala' jantak snib'ej heb'.
Haxo yik ix lajwi swa heb' sik'lab'il, ix yalan Jesús t'a heb' sk'ayb'um chi': --Molek jantakto ix kan chi', yik malaj tas tz'ixtaxi, xchi t'a heb'.
Haxo ix lajwi smolan heb' chi', lajchaweto xu'uk ix b'ut'ji yuj ixim pan ix yak' sobre t'a ixim oye' pan cebada chi'.
Ha heb' anima chi', ix yil heb' jun tas satub'tak ix sch'ox Jesús chi'. Yuj chi' ix yal heb': --Haton jun tik, schekab' Dios tanhwab'iltaxon sja t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, xchi heb'.
Palta yojtakxo Jesús to snib'ej heb' yak'an pural yoch sreyalok. Yuj chi' ix sb'esel sb'a t'a skal heb', ix b'atkan t'a skal lum tzalkixtak chi' sch'okoj.
Ayik wanxo sk'ik'b'i, ix emk'och heb' sk'ayb'um Jesús t'a sti' ha' nhajab'.
Ix och heb' t'a yol te' barco, ix b'atxi heb'. Snib'ej heb' sk'axpajek' t'a chonhab' Capernaum ay t'a sti' ha' nhajab' chi'. Te k'ik'b'alxo ix b'at heb'. Manto jaxlaj Jesús ix b'at heb'.
Haxo yik wan sb'ey heb', ix owajcha'anh jun ik' te ow t'a sat ha' nhajab' chi'. Ix te k'e chulan ha' yuj jun ik' chi'.
Ayxom junok nanhal schab'il legua sb'at heb' t'a sat ha', haxo ix yilan heb' wan sk'och Jesús t'a heb'. Tonhej sb'eyb'at t'a sat ha'. Yuj chi' ix te xiwk'e heb'.
Palta ix yalan t'a heb': --Manh ex xiwok, Ha in, xchi t'a heb'.
Ichato chi' junk'olalxo ix chaji'och yuj heb' t'a yol te' barco chi'. Elanhchamel ix ek'k'och heb' t'a sk'axepal ha' b'aj wan sk'och heb' chi'.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u, hanheja' yajkan heb' anima chi' t'a sk'axepal ha' chi'. Haxo ix sna'ankot heb' to junnhej te' barco chi' ix b'ati, anhej pax heb' sk'ayb'um Jesús ix och t'a yol te', maj ochlaj Jesús chi' yet' heb'.
Yakb'an chi' ay juntzanhxo barco ix kot t'a chonhab' Tiberias, ix k'och t'a slak'anil jun lugar b'aj ix swa ixim pan chi' heb', haton b'aj ix yak' yuj diosal Kajalil yuj ixim.

Haxo ix yilan heb' anima chi', manhxo ayok ek' Jesús chi' yet' heb' yet' pax heb' sk'ayb'um. Yuj chi' ix laj och heb' t'a yol juntzanh barco chi'. Ix b'at sayanek' Jesús chi' heb' t'a chonhab' Capernaum.

Haxo ix k'och heb' anima chi' t'a sk'axepalek' ha' nhajab' chi', hata' ix ilchaj Jesús yuj heb'. Ix sk'anb'an heb' t'ay: --Ach ko k'ayb'umal, ¿tom t'a tik ayach ek'i? ¿Janik' ach jawi? xchi heb' t'ay.
Ix yalan t'a heb': --Wal yel swal t'ayex, yujnhej to ex b'ut'ji he wa'an ixim pan, yuj chi' tzin he saya', manh yujok to ix nachajel eyu'uj tas syalelk'och juntzanh satub'tak ix in ch'ox chi'.

Manh eyak' eyip he sayan ek' tas swaji, yujto elanhchamel slajwi'eli. Palta sayekek' jun wa'el max lajwi'el-laj, yujto ha' ol ak'an he k 'inal t'a junelnhej. Ol wak' jun chi' t'ayex, yujto Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch anima'il, a ko Mam Dios sch'oxaneli to chab'il in yuj, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'an heb' t'ay: --¿Tas ol kutok ko k'ulan tas snib'ej Dios sko k'ulej chi'? xchi heb' t'ay.
Ix yalanxi Jesús chi' t'a heb': --Haton jun tik snib'ej Dios tze k'ulej, to tzin eyak' wal och t'a he k'o'ol, yujto a chekjinak in koti, xchi t'a heb'.
Ix sk'anb'anxi heb' t'ay: --¿Tas wal junok satub'tak tza ch'ox kila' yik ol ach kak'och t'a ko k'o'ol? ¿Tas tza k'ulej?

Ha heb' ko mam kicham ek'nak t'a peka', yilnak jun tas satub'tak heb', swanak jun maná heb' t'a takinh lu'um icha syal t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani. Haton jun tz'alan icha tik: Ha Dios ak'jinakkot tas swa heb' t'a satcha'anh, xchi, xchi heb' t'a Jesús chi'.
Yuj chi' ix yalanxi Jesús chi' t'a heb': --Wal yel swal t'ayex, manhoklaj winhaj Moisés tz'ak'an jun wa'el yik satcha'anh chi'. Palta a in Mam tz'ak'an jun wa'el te yel skot t'a satcha'anh.
Yujto a jun wa'el syak' Dios tik, ha t'a satcha'anh emnakkoti. Ay heb' ay t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik ol scha sk'inal t'a junelnhej yuj, xchi Jesús.
Ix yalanxi heb': --Mamin, ak' jun wa'el chi' t'ayonh t'a masanil tiempo, xchi heb' t'ay.
Ix yalanxi t'a heb': --Ha in ton tik icha wa'el waji, Ak'um in k 'inal. Ha heb' sja t'ayin, manhxa b'ak'inh ol och swejel heb'. Ha heb' tzin ak'anoch t'a sk'o'ol, manhxa b'ak'inh ol takjok sti' heb'.
Palta toxo ix wal t'ayex, wach'chom tzin heyila', max in eyak'och t'a he k'o'ol.
Masanil heb' tz'ak'ji t'ayin yuj in Mam, ol ja heb' t'ayin. Ha heb' sjawi t'ayin, manh ol in pechel heb'.
Ha in tik, kotnak in t'a satcha'anh yik tzul in b'o icha snib'ej Dios chekjinak in koti. Manh yujok ul in b'o'an icha tas tzin nib'ej kotnak in.
Ha tas snib'ej in Mam chekjinak in koti, to manh ol satel junok mach t'a skal heb' syak' t'ayin. Snib'ej to a in ol wak' pitzwokxi heb' t'a slajwub' k'uhal.

Ha in tik, Yuninal in Dios. Yuj chi' jantaknhej heb' tzin hilani, tato tzin yak'och heb' t'a sk'o'ol, snib'ej in Mam chi' to scha sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej. Yuj chi' a in ol wak' pitzwokxi heb' t'a slajwub' k'uhal, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Ayik ix yab'an juntzanh chi' heb' aj Judea, chuk tas ix yalub'tanhej heb' t'a spatik Jesús chi', yujto ix yala': Ha in ton tik icha wa'el waji, kotnak in t'a satcha'anh, xchi t'a heb'.
Yuj chi' ix yalan heb': --Ha Jesús tik, yuninal winhaj José. Kojtak smam snun winh, palta syala' to t'a satcha'anh kotnak, xchi heb' aj Judea chi'.
Palta ix yalanxi Jesús t'a heb': --Manh in eyalub'tanhej.
Ha in Mam chekjinak in koti. Malaj junok mach syal skomon ja t'ayin, scha'an sk'inal tato manhok in Mam tz'ak'ankot t'ayin. Ha heb' sja t'ayin, ol wak' pitzwokxi heb' t'a slajwub' k'uhal.

Tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj heb' schekab' Dios icha tik: Ol k'ayb'aj masanil anima yuj Dios, xchi heb'. Yuj chi', a jantaknhej heb' syak'och schikin t'a tas syal ko Mam Dios, tato snachajel yuj heb' tas syala', ol ja heb' t'ayin.
Manh wanok walani to ay mach ix ilan ko Mam Dios. Palta a in tik, a t'ay kotnak in, a innhej wilnak.
Wal yel swal t'ayex, a mach tzin ak'anoch t'a sk'o'ol, ay sk'inal t'a junelnhej.
Ha in tik, icha wa'el waji, Ak'um in k 'inal.
Ha heb' ko mam kicham, swanak jun maná heb' t'a takinh lu'um, palta hanhejtona' chamnak heb' smasanil.
Palta a heb' swa'an jun wa'el kotnak t'a satcha'anh, malaj b'ak'inh ol cham heb'.

Ha in kotnak in t'a satcha'anh tik, icha wa'el waji, yujto Ak'um in k 'inal. Yuj chi', a heb' swa'an jun wa'el tik, ay sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej. Ha jun wa'el swak' wajok tik, haton in niwanil, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Haxo heb' aj Judea chi', ix stelaj sb'a heb' yuj tas ix yal chi', ix laj yalan heb': --Ha jun winh tik, ¿tas ol yutok winh yak'an sniwanil ko chi sna'ani? xchi heb'.
Yuj chi' ix yalxi t'a heb': --Wal yel swal t'ayex, tato manh ol he chi in niwanil a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch anima'il tik, manh ol eyuk'anpaxlaj in chik'il, manh ol he chalaj he k 'inal.
Yuj chi', yalnhej mach tz'ab'lan in niwanil tik, syuk'anpax in chik'il, ay sk'inal t'a junelnhej. Ha in ol wak' pitzwokxi t'a slajwub' k'uhal.
Yujto a jun in niwanil tik, yel lajan yopisio yet' tas swaji. Ha in chik'il lajan yopisio yet' tas tz'uk'ji.
Yalnhej mach schi'an in niwanil tik, syuk'an pax in chik'il, junxonhej tz'ajkan wet'ok. Ayin pax och t'ay.
Ha ko Mam Dios pitzan t'a masanil tiempo, a chekjinak in koti. Yuj pitzan in. Yuj chi', a mach schi'an in niwanil tik, ol wak' sk'inal.

Ha tikne'ik, wan walan yuj jun icha wa'el kotnak t'a satcha'anh. Ha jun tik, manh lajanok yet' jun maná swanak heb' ko mam kicham t'a peka'. Niwanok swanak heb', palta chamnak pax heb'. Palta a mach ol wa'an jun icha wa'el tik, ol scha sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Ha t'a yol spatil culto t'a chonhab' Capernaum, hata' ix yal juntzanh k'ayb'ub'al tik Jesús.
Ayik ix yab'an juntzanh chi' jantak heb' anima tzak'anoch yuj Jesús chi', ix yalan heb': --Te ya juntzanh slolonel syal tik. ¿Tom ay mach syal scha'an yab'i? xchi heb'.
Haxo Jesús chi', yojtakxo tas jun syal heb' chi', yuj chi' ix yalanxi t'a heb': --¿Tom a jun tik tz'ik'an somchajel he k'o'ol?
Ha in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch anima'il tik, tato ol eyil in k'ex b'aj kotnak in, ¿tas ol eyutok eyalani?
Ha Espíritu tz'ak'an k 'inal. Haxo ko niwanil tik malaj yopisio. Ha juntzanh lolonel ix wal tik t'ayex, te yel, yik pax Espíritu, a tz'ak'an k 'inal t'a junelnhej.

Palta ayex max in eyak'och t'a he k'o'ol, xchi t'a heb'. Icha chi' ix yutej yalan t'a heb', yujto atax t'a yichb'anel yojtaktaxoni mach heb' max ak'anoch t'a sk'o'ol. Yojtak paxi mach jun ol ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' chamel.
Ix yalanxi: --Yujto ayex maj in eyak'och t'a he k'o'ol, yuj chi' walnak t'ayex, malaj junok mach syal skomon ja t'ayin tato manhok in Mam tz'ak'ankot heb' t'ayin, xin chi, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Atax ta', tzijtum heb' tzak'anoch yuj ix meltzajxi t'a spatik. Manhxa snib'ej heb' tz'och tzak'an yuj.
Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'an Jesús t'a heb' lajchawa'anh: --Xal ex tik, ¿ay am pax he gana tzex meltzajxi t'a he patik? xchi t'a heb'.
Haxo winhaj Simón Pedro ix tak'wi t'ay: --Mamin, ¿mach b'aj ol onh och tzak'an jun? Malaj junxo mach icha tik sloloni yik sko cha ko k 'inal t'a junelnhej.
Ha onh tik, toxo ix ach kak'och t'a ko k'o'ol. Kojtak, a ach tik Sik'b'il ach el yuj Dios, xchi winhaj Pedro chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jesús t'a heb': --Ha ex he lajchawanhil, a in ex in sik'kaneli. Palta ay jun t'a he kal, schekab' winh diablo yaji, xchi t'a heb'.
Ha jun ix yal chi', haton winhaj Judas yuninal winhaj Simón aj Queriot. Yujto a winhaj Judas chi' ol ak'anoch Jesús t'a yol sk'ab' chamel. Palta yetk'ayb'umal sb'a winh yet' heb' uxluchwanh chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix och ijan Jesús yek' t'a yol yik Galilea. Haxo t'a yol yik Judea, malaj snib'ej ix ek' ta', yujto a heb' winh aj Judea chi', snib'ej heb' winh smilanchamok.
Wan sja stiempo'al sk'inh heb' israel skuch k'inh chinama.
Yuj chi' ix yal heb' yuk'tak Jesús chi' t'ay: --Manh ach kan t'a tik. Ixik t'a Judea, yik wach' a heb' a k'ayb'um ayek' ta', ol yil pax heb' tastak satub'tak tza ch'oxo'.

Tato ay junok mach snib'ej scheklajel t'a yichanh heb' anima, max yal-laj elk'altak tz'ek'i. Yuj chi', tato yel ay juntzanh satub'tak tza ch'oxo', yowalil tza ch'oxel a b'a t'a yichanh heb' anima, xchi heb' t'ay.
Ix stz'ak yal heb' yuk'tak t'ay icha chi', yujto max yak'och Jesús chi' heb' t'a sk'o'ol.
Yuj chi' ix yal t'a heb': --Manto stiempo'alok in ch'oxanel in b'a. Ha exxo tik, yalnhej tas tiempo'al syal he na'ani.
Ha heb' ay t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik heyet'ok, max ex schakel-laj heb'. Ha inxo tik, tzin schakel heb', yujto tzin ch'oxeli to malaj swach'il sb'eyb'al heb'.
Ixikek he ch'okoj t'a jun k'inh chi'. Yujto a in tik, manto ol in k'ek'ochlaj, yujto manto stiempo'alok in ch'oxanel in b'a, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi yalan juntzanh chi', ix kan yuj heb' t'a Galilea chi'.
Palta haxo yik toxo ix k'e heb' yuk'tak Jesús chi', ix k'e paxi, palta elk'altaknhej ix aj sk'e'i.
Ha heb' aj Judea, ix smaklej heb' sk'och Jesús chi' t'a jun k'inh chi'. --¿B'ajtil ayek' jun winak chi'? xchi heb'.
Manh jantakok yalub'tanhan heb' anima. Ay heb' tz'alani: Te wach' winh, xchi heb'. Ay pax heb' tz'alanxi: Ma'ay, syak' heb' anima winh musansatil, xchi heb'.
Palta elk'altak syalub'tanhej heb', yujto xiw heb' yab'an heb' winh aj Judea chi'.
Wanxo snanhalb'i jun k'inh chi', ix k'ek'och Jesús t'a yamak'il templo. Ix och ijan sk'ayb'an heb' anima ta'.
Haxo heb' ay yopisio t'a skal heb' aj Judea chi', ix te sat sk'ol heb' yab'ani. Ix laj yalan heb': --¿Tas wal syutej yojtakanel juntzanh syal tik? Ina manh k'ayb'ab'ilok, xchi heb'.
Yuj chi' ix yalan Jesús chi' t'a heb': --Ha juntzanh k'ayb'ub'al swal t'ayex tik, manh wikok. Yik Dios chekjinak in koti.
Tato ay heb' syal sk'ol sk'ulej icha snib'ej Dios, ol nachajel yuj heb' tato yik Dios juntzanh k'ayb'ub'al tik, mato munil swal t'a yol wiko'.

Ha mach slolon t'a yol yiko', tonhej syik'cha'anh sb'a, yik ay yelk'och t'a yichanh heb' anima sna'ani. Palta a in tik, in gana ha Dios chekjinak in kot ay yelk'och t'a eyichanh. Yuj chi', te yel swala'. Malaj jab'ok es swala'.
Haton wal winhaj Moisés ak'jinakkan sley Dios t'ayex. Palta ina malaj junok ex tze k'anab'ajej tas syal jun ley chi'. ¿Tas yuj he gana tzin he milchamok? xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Haxo heb' anima ayek' chi' ta', ix yal heb' t'ay: --Ha ach tik, tekan ayoch junok enemigo t'ayach. ¿Mach junok snib'ej ach smilancham tzila'? xchi heb' t'ay.
Yuj chi' ix yalanxi t'a heb': --Ay jun tas ix in k'ulej t'a sk'uhal ik'oj ip. E masanil ix sat he k'o'ol yuj.

Yuj heb' ko mam kicham t'a peka', elnakkan yich jun b'eyb'al skuch circuncisión. Haxo winhaj Moisés aljinakkani to yowalil sko b'eyb'alej jun chi'. Yuj chi' wach'chom sk'uhal ik'oj ip, slaj eyak' circuncidar heb' unin tzato alji.

Ha ex tik tzeyak' circuncidar heb' unin t'a sk'uhal ik'oj ip, yik max ex ek' t'a yib'anh jun ley Moisés chi'. Tato icha chi', ¿tas yuj skot eyowal t'ayin yujto ix wak' b'oxok sk'ol jun winh pena'ay t'a sk'uhal ik'oj ip chi'?
Manh he komon ch'olb'itej junok mach t'a ichnhejta'. Tato ay mach tze ch'olb'itej, t'a stojolal tzeyutej he ch'olb'itani, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Yuj chi' ay jaywanh heb' aj Jerusalén ix halani: --Ha jun winh tik, ¿tom manhok winh snib'ej heb' smilchamok?
Palta ina yajek' winh tik, wan slolon winh t'a ko kal. Ina malaj jab'ok tas syal heb' t'a winh. Tekan toxo ix sna'el heb' yajal chi' to a Cristo.
Ayik ol ja Cristo chi', malaj mach ojtannak b'aj ol kotok. Palta a jun winh tik, kojtak b'aj kotnak winh, xchi heb'.

Yakb'an wan sk'ayb'an heb' anima chi' Jesús t'a yamak'il templo chi', te cha'anh ix yalelta t'a skal heb': --Ina eyojtak in. Eyojtakpax b'aj kotnak in. Palta manh munilok in ja t'a yol wiko'. Ha Dios te yel chekjinak in koti. Palta ha Dios chi' manh eyojtakok.
Ha inxo tik wojtak, yujto hata' kotnak in. A' chekjinak in koti, xchi t'a heb'.
Yuj chi' ay heb' ix halani to tz'ak'ji'och t'a preso. Palta malaj mach ix yamani, yujto manto k'och stiempo'al schami.
Tzijtum heb' anima ix ak'anoch Jesús t'a sk'o'ol, ix yalan heb': --Ayik ol jawok Cristo, ¿tom más ek'to tas satub'tak ol sch'ox t'a yichanh jun winh tik? xchi heb'.

Ix yab' heb' winh fariseo tas syal heb' anima yuj Jesús. Yuj chi', a heb' winh yet' heb' winh sat sacerdote ix chekanb'at juntzanh heb' stanhwumal stemplo Dios, yik b'at yik'kot Jesús heb', yik syak'anoch heb' t'a preso sna'ani.
Haxo Jesús ix halan t'a heb' anima: --Jayexonhej k'uhal ayinek' heyet'ok, ol lajwok chi' ol in meltzaj t'a mach chekjinak in koti.
Ha exxo tik, ol in he sayek'i, palta manhxo ol in ilchaj eyu'uj, yujto max yal he k'och b'aj ol in k'och chi', xchi t'a heb'.

Haxo heb' aj Judea chi', ix laj yal heb': --¿B'ajtil ol k'och winh sna'ani, yuj chi' syal winh to manhxo ol ilchaj winh ku'uj? Ina ay heb' ketchonhab' ayb'at t'a skal heb' griego. ¿Tom snib'ej winh hata' ol k'och t'a skal heb', sb'at sk'ayb'an masanil heb' griego chi' winh sna'ani?

Ina ix yal winh t'ayonh: Ha ex tik, ol in he sayek'i, palta manhxo ol in ilchaj eyu'uj, yujto max yal he k'och b'aj ol in k'ochok, xchi winh t'ayonh. ¿Tas wal syalelk'och jun ix yal winh tik t'ayonh? xchi heb'.

Ha t'a slajwub' k'uhal k'inh chi', haton jun k'u te niwan yelk'ochi, hata' ix elta linhan Jesús t'a yichanh heb' anima. Te cha'anh ix yalelta t'a skal heb': --Tato ayex tze nib'ej tze cha he k 'inal t'a junelnhej, kotanhek t'ayin. Icha tz'aj eyuk'an ha ha', ayik stakji he ti', icha chi' ol aj he cha'an he k 'inal t'ayin.

Tato ayex tzin eyak'och t'a he k'o'ol, icha to ay jun ha ha' tz'el yok ol pak' t'ayex. Haton jun chi' tz'ak'an he k 'inal t'a junelnhej. Yujto icha chi' syalkan t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani, xchi Jesús t'a heb' anima chi'.

Icha chi' ix yutej yalani to a heb' tz'ak'anoch t'a sk'o'ol, ol ak'jokoch Yespíritu Dios t'a heb'. Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', manto ak'ji Yespíritu Dios t'a heb' anima, yujto manto k'ex Jesús t'a satcha'anh.
Ixlajwi yab'an heb' anima tas ix yal Jesús chi', ay heb' ix laj halani: --Wal yel, haton jun tik schekab' Dios tanhwab'iltaxon sja ku'uj, xchi heb'.
Ay pax heb' ix laj halani: --Ha jun tik haton Cristo, xchi heb'. Palta ay heb' ix alanxi: --Ha Cristo chi', ¿tom aj Galilea icha jun winh tik tze na'a?
Ha Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkan tz'alani to a Cristo yowalil ol aljok t'a chonhab' Belén b'aj ek'nak winhaj David t'a peka', yujto yinhtilalkan winhaj David chi', xchi heb'.
Yuj chi' ix och ijan heb' anima stelan sb'a yuj Jesús chi'.
Ay heb' snib'ej syak'och t'a preso, palta malaj mach syamani.

Haxo heb' stanhwumal stemplo Dios, hanheja' sch'okoj heb' ix k'ochxi b'aj aykan heb' winh ix chekanb'at heb' chi', haton heb' winh fariseo yet' heb' winh sat sacerdote. Yuj chi' ix yalan heb' winh t'a heb': --¿Tas yuj maj eyik'kot Jesús chi'? xchi heb' winh.
--Malaj junok mach stzak'wan slolon icha slolon chi', xchi heb'.
Yuj chi' ix yalanpax heb' winh fariseo chi' t'a heb': --¿Tom ix ex ak'jipax musansatil a ex tik?
¿Tom ay junok ko yajalil ix ak'anoch winh t'a sk'o'ol? Hanhejtona' a onh fariseo onh tik, ¿tok ay junok onh ix kak'och winh t'a ko k'o'ol?
Anhej heb' komon anima ix ak'anoch winh t'a sk'o'ol. Palta a heb' chi', manh yojtakok jab'ok ley Moisés heb'. Yuj chi' aykot yowal sk'ol Dios t'a yib'anh heb', xchi heb' winh fariseo chi'.
Palta ay jun winh fariseo chi' skuch Nicodemo. Haton jun winh xit'nakek' lolonel yet' Jesús t'ak'walil. Ix yalan winh t'a heb':
--Ha jun ley aykan t'ayonh, syala' to manh sleyalok skak'b'at t'a yib'anh junok anima, tato manto kab'i tas smul, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Yuj chi' ix yalanxi heb' t'a winh: --¿Tom aj Galilea ach yet' winh? k'ayb'ej Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani. Hata' ol ila' to manhoklaj t'a Galilea ol kot winh schekab' Dios tanhwab'il ku'uj, xchi heb' t'a winh.
[Ix laj pax junjun heb' t'a spat.
Haxo Jesús ix b'at t'a tzalan Olivo.
Wanxo sakb'i, ix k'ochxi t'a yol yamak'il templo chi'. Ayik ix k'och ta', masanil heb' anima ix k'och yet'ok. Ix em k'ojan, ix sk'ayb'an heb'.

Haxo heb' winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés yet' heb' winh fariseo ix ik'ankot jun ix ix t'a Jesús, ix yamchaj ix yuj heb' winh ayik wan smulan ix. Ix ak'ji'och ix yuj heb' winh t'a yichanh Jesús yet' heb' ayek' yet'ok.
Ix yalan heb' winh t'ay: --Ach ko k'ayb'umal, a jun ix ix tik, wan smulan ix ayik ix yamchaj ix ku'uj.
Ha ley Moisés tz'alani, tato ay junok ix ix sk'ulan icha tik, yowalil sjulk'enajcham ix. Xal ach, ¿tas xa chi? xchi heb' winh t'ay.

Palta tonhej stz'ak sk'anb'ej heb' winh, yik syil heb' winh tas syal Jesús chi', yujto snib'ej heb' winh yak'anoch t'a yib'anh. Palta tonhej ix em nhojan, wan stz'ib'an yet' yiximal sk'ab' t'a sat lu'um.

Ix sk'anb'anxi heb' winh t'ay: --¿Tas xa chi yuj jun tik jun? xchi heb' winh t'ay. Yuj chi' ix k'e k'elan, ix yalan t'a heb' winh: --Tato ay junok ex malaj jab'ok he mul, b'ab'laj julejekoch k'e'en t'a ix, xchi t'a heb' winh.
Ixlajwi yalan juntzanh chi', ix emxi nhojan, ix stz'ib'anxi'em juntzanhxo tas t'a sat lu'um chi'.

Ayik ix yab'an jun tik heb' winh, ix laj sna'an sb'a junjun heb' winh, aynhej smul heb' winh. Yuj chi' junjunal ix laj b'at heb' winh. Ha heb' winh ichamtak winak ix b'ab'laj b'ati, haxo heb' winh kelemtak, tzak'anto ix laj b'at heb' winh. Haxonhej Jesús ix kan sch'okoj b'aj linhanek' jun ix ix chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix k'e k'elan Jesús chi', ix yilani sch'okojxonhej ix ayek'i. Yuj chi' ix yalan t'a ix: --Ach ix, ¿b'aj ay heb' winh wan yak'anoch chi' t'a ib'anh? ¿Tom malaj junok heb' winh tz'ak'anoch t'a ib'anh? xchi t'a ix.
--Ma'ay Mamin, manhxalaj heb' winh, xchi ix. --Hanhejtona' in, malaj tas swak'och t'a ib'anh. Yuj chi' ixik. Manhxo ach mulan junelxo, xchi Jesús chi' t'a ix.]

Ix yalanxi Jesús t'a heb' anima: --Ha in tik, icha sakil k'inal waj t'a heb' anima t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Ha mach tz'och tzak'an wu'uj, ol wak' sakil k'inal t'ay. Yuj jun sakil k'inal chi', ol scha sk'inal t'a junelnhej. Manhxo ol b'eyek' t'a k'ik' k'inal, xchi Jesús.
Haxo heb' winh fariseo ix halan t'ay: --Ha ach tik, yolnhej ik tzala' to ay opisio. Yuj chi' malaj yelk'och jab' ik tzal chi', xchi heb' winh t'ay.

Ix yalanxi t'a heb' winh: --Wach'chom munil swala' to ay wopisio, palta toton yel swala', yujto a in tik wojtak b'aj kotnak in. Hanhejtona', wojtak b'ajtil ol in k'ochxok. Ha exxo tik, manh eyojtakok b'aj kotnak in, hanhejtona' manh eyojtakok b'aj ol in k'ochpaxok.
Ha ex tik, tonhej tze komon ch'olb'itej yaj junok anima t'a elanhchamel. Xal in, malaj mach tzin ch'olb'itej yaji.

Palta k'inalok tato a in tzin ch'olb'itej yaj junok anima, tojolnhej swutej in ch'olb'itan yaji. Yujto manhok innhej tzin ch'olb'itej yaji, yujto a in Mam chekjinak in koti, a sch'olb'itan pax wet'ok.
Ha jun ley aykan t'ayonh, a tz'alani: Tato ay chawanhok testigo lajan syutej yalani, yowalil sko cha kab' tas syal heb'.
Palta ina ay chawanh testigo tz'alan wu'uj. Ha in ton tik testigo in. Testigo pax in Mam wet'ok, haton chekjinak in koti, xchi t'a heb' winh.

--Palta ¿b'ajtil ay a Mam chi'? xchi heb' winh t'ay. Yuj chi' ix yalanpax t'a heb' winh: --Ha ex tik, manh eyojtakok mach in. Manh eyojtakok pax in Mam chi'. Oktom tzin eyojtakejeli mach in, yik ol eyojtakej pax in Mam chi', xchi t'a heb' winh.
Ha t'a yol yamak'il templo t'a slak'anil jun chalab' ofrenda, hata' ix yal juntzanh chi' Jesús. Hata' ix k'ayb'aj heb' anima yuj. Malaj junok mach ix yamani, yujto manto k'och stiempo'al schami.
Ix yalan Jesús t'a heb' winh: --Ha in tik ol in b'atok. Ha exxo tik ol in he sayek'i, palta ha t'a skal he mul ol ex chamok. Manh ol yal he komon k'och b'aj ol in k'och chi', xchi t'a heb' winh.
Yuj chi', ix laj yal heb' winh aj Judea chi': --Tekan ol smilcham sb'a winh, yuj chi' ix yal winh to max yal ko k'och b'aj ol k'och winh chi', xchi heb' winh.
Ix yalanxi t'a heb' winh: --Ha ex tik, aj sat lu'um ex, yujto yik ex yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Xal in tik, manh in yikok yol yib'anhk'inal tik, yujto aj satcha'anh in.
Yuj chi' swal t'ayex, t'a skal he mul ol ex chamok. Tato max eyak'och t'a he k'o'ol to Ha In Ton Tik, ha t'a skal he mul ol ex chamok, xchi.
--¿Mach ach jun? xchi heb' winh t'ay. Palta ina walnakxo t'ayex t'a yalanhtaxo, mach in.
Tzijtumto tas ol wal eyu'uj yet' ex in ch'olb'itani. Ha jun chekjinak in koti, te yel syala'. Ha tas yalnakkan t'ayin, anhej chi' swal t'ayex a ex ayex t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, xchi t'a heb' winh.
Palta max nachajel yuj heb' winh tato a ko Mam Dios wan yalani.

Yuj chi' ix yalanxi t'a heb' winh: --Hato yik ol in he t'unhb'ank'e a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch anima'il tik, hato ta' ol nachajel eyu'uj to Ha In Toni. Hata' ol nachajel eyu'uj to malaj tas munil tzin k'ulej in ch'okoj. Anhej juntzanh k'ayb'ub'al yalnak in Mam t'ayin, anhej swala'.
Ha Dios in chekankoti, ay paxoch wet'ok. Max in yaktejkan in ch'okoj, yujto anhej tas snib'ej tzin k'ulej t'a masanil tiempo, xchi t'a heb' winh.
Ayik ix yalan juntzanh chi' Jesús, tzijtum heb' ix ak'anoch sk'o'ol t'ay.
Haxo ix yalan Jesús t'a heb' israel ix ak'anoch t'a sk'o'ol: --Tato masanil tiempo tzeyak'och he pensar t'a in lolonel, yelton wal in k'ayb'um ex.
Tato icha chi', ol eyojtakejel slolonel Dios te yel. Yuj jun lolonel yel chi', ol ex el t'a libre, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Palta ix yalanxi heb' t'ay: --Ha onh tik yinhtil onh pax Abraham het'ok. Malaj junelok ix onh och schekab'ok junok anima. ¿Tas yuj tzala' to ol onh el t'a libre? xchi heb'.
Wal yel swal t'ayex, a mach hanheja' sk'ulan chukal, chekab' yaj t'a chukal chi'.
K'inalok ay junok schekab' junok anima tikne'ik, max yal skajnaj yet' jun anima chi' t'a junelnhej. Palta a junok yuninal jun anima chi', wal yel yuninal yaj t'a junelnhej.
Yuj chi' tato a in tzex wak'el t'a libre, wal yel libre tzex ajkani, yujto yuninal in Dios.
Ha in tik, wojtakxo to yinhtil ex kan winhaj Abraham chi' wet'ok. Palta ina he gana tzin he milchamok yujto a tas swala' malaj tz'och t'ayex.
Ha tas wilnak t'a in Mam, a swal t'ayex. Ha exxo tik, ch'ok jun he mam wan he k'anab'ajan tas syal t'ayex, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Palta a winhaj Abraham chi' ko mam yaj winh, xchi heb' t'ay. --Oktom wal yel yinhtil ex winh, tato icha chi', tzam he k'anab'ajej icha sk'ulejnak winh.
Ha juntzanh tas yel yalnakkan Dios t'ayin, anhej swal t'ayex. Palta ina he gana tzin he milchamok. Manh ichokta' ix yutej sb'a winhaj Abraham chi'.
Ha ex tik, a tas sk'ulej jun he mam tze k'anab'ajej, xchi Jesús t'a heb'. --Palta a onh tik, manh onh mitz'uninoklaj. Junnhej ko Mam, haton Dios, xchi heb' t'ay.
--Oktom yel to yuninal ex Dios chi'. Tato icha chi' tzam in he xajanej, yujto a in tik t'a Dios kotnak in, in ja t'a tik. Manh yolok wik in jawi, yujto ha Dios chekjinak in koti.
¿Tas yuj max nachajel eyu'uj tas swal t'ayex? Tekan malaj he gana tze cha eyab' tas swal tik.

Ha ex tik, a jun he mam, haton winh diablo. Yuj chi', anhej t'a winh tzeyak'och he pensar. Anhej tas snib'ej winh tze k'ulej. Yiktax ix b'oji yol yib'anhk'inal tik, milumcham anima winh. Malaj yelk'och jab'ok tas yel t'a winh, yujto anhej es snib'ej winh. Ayik syesan winh, t'a spensar winh skoti, yujto esalwum winh. Ha t'a winh pitzwinakkot es chi'.
Ha inxo tik, yujto a juntzanh tas te yel swal t'ayex, yuj chi' max he cha eyab'i.
¿Mach junok ex syal he ch'oxanel jab'ok in mul? Te yel juntzanh tas swal t'ayex tik. Yuj chi', ¿tas yuj max he cha eyab'i?
Ha heb' yik Dios, syak'och schikin heb' t'a slolonel. Palta a exxo tik, manh ex yikok Dios, yuj chi' max yal he k'ol tzeyak'och he chikin t'ay, xchi Jesús t'a heb' winh.
Ix yalanpax heb' winh aj Judea chi' t'ay: --Tekan yel skala' to aj Samaria ach, tekan to ayoch junok enemigo t'ayach, xchi heb' t'ay.
--Ma'ay, malaj junok enemigo ayoch t'ayin. Wan in k'anab'ajan tas syal in Mam. Palta a ex tik, tonhej tzex b'uchwaj t'ayin.
Ha in tik, malaj in gana ay welk'ochi. Palta ay junxo tz'alani to ay welk'och t'a sat. Ha jun chi sch'olb'itani mach yel syala'.
Wal yel swal t'ayex, a heb' sk'anab'ajan tas swala', malaj b'ak'inh ol cham heb', xchi t'a heb' winh.

--Ha tikne'ik skojtakejeli to ayoch enemigo t'ayach. Ha winhaj Abraham yet' jantaknhej heb' schekab' Dios t'a peka', chamnakxo heb' smasanil. Ha hachxo tik tzala': Tato ay mach sk'anab'ajan tas swala', malaj b'ak'inh ol chamok, niwanok xa chi.
¿Tom ek'to elk'och t'a yichanh winh ko mam kicham aj Abraham chi'? Ina chamnak winh, chamnakxo pax heb' schekab' Dios chi', ¿mach ach a na'an tikne'ik? xchi heb' winh t'ay.
Yuj chi' ix yalxi t'a heb' winh: --Tato munil swik'cha'anh in b'a, malaj welk'ochi. Palta a in Mam tz'alani to ay welk'ochi. Ha in Mam chi' tzeyaloch he Diosalok,

palta niwanok tzeyal icha chi', yujto manh eyojtakok Dios chi'. Ha in tik, wojtak sik'lab'il. K'inalok swala' to manh wojtakok, swesej icha ex tik. Palta yel wojtak, yujto a tas syala', a tzin k'anab'ajejnhej.
Ha winh ko mam kicham aj Abraham chi', tzalajnak winh yujto aljinak t'a winh to ol yil winh in jawi. Ix yilan winh, yuj chi' ix te tzalaj winh, xchi t'a heb' winh.
--¿Tom ilnakto winhaj Abraham chi'? Ina manto ach k'och t'a 50 ab'il, xchi heb' winh t'ay.
--Wal yel swal t'ayex, ayik manto alji winhaj Abraham chi', ayintaxonek'i, xchi Jesús chi' t'a heb' winh.
Ix laj sik'ank'e k'e'en k'e'en heb' winh yik sjulanoch k'e'en heb' winh t'ay. Ix sk'ub'anel sb'a t'a heb' winh, ix elta t'a yamak'il templo chi'. Ix ek'b'at t'a skal heb' winh, ix b'ati.
Ayik wan yek' Jesús, ix yilanb'at jun winh max ujitaxon yilani.
Haxo heb' sk'ayb'um ix k'anb'an t'ay: --Ach ko k'ayb'umal, ¿tas am yuj max yal yilan jun winh tik yiktax yaljub'al? ¿tom yuj smul smam snun winh, mato yuj smul winh? xchi heb' t'a Jesús.

Ix yalan Jesús chi' t'a heb': --Ha jun winh tik, manh yujok smul smam snun winh, manh yujok pax smul winh icha chi' yajkani. Yujto snib'ej Dios sch'ox tas satub'tak yuj winh, yuj chi' icha tik yaj winh.
Yowalil tzin b'o smunlajel Dios, haton chekjinak in koti, yakb'an ayto k'u, yujto ayik toxo ix b'at k'u, manhxalaj mach syal smunlaji.
Ayik ayin to ek' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, icha sakil k'inal waj t'a heb' anima, xchi Jesús chi'.
Ixlajwi yalan juntzanh chi', ix tzub'anem t'a sat lu'um. Ix och jab' lum sok'omal yuj stzub' chi'. Ix sukanoch lum t'a yol sat winh max yal yilan chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan t'a winh: --Ixik, b'at b'ikel t'a jun b'aj molb'ab'il ha ha' skuch Siloé, xchi t'a winh. (Siloé syalelk'ochi, Ak'b'ilkoti.) Ix b'at sb'ikanel winh, haxo ix meltzaj winh, tzaxo yal yilan winh.
Haxo ix yilan heb' ay t'a spatik schikin spat winh yet' juntzanhxo heb' tz'ilantaxon sk'anan stumin winh, ix laj yalan heb': --¿Tom manhok jun winh tik tz'em k'ojan k'anoj tumin? xchi heb'.

--Ha winh jun, xchi juntzanh heb'. Palta ay juntzanhxo heb' ix halani: --Ma'ay. Ha jun winh tik, tonhej lajan yilji winh yet' jun winh max yal yilan chi', xchi heb'. Palta haxo winh ix halani: --Ha in toni, xchi winh.
--¿Tas ix aj sb'o ilan jun? xchi heb' t'a winh.

--Ha jun winh skuchan Jesús ixb'o'an jab' lum sok'om, ix sukanoch winh t'a yol in sat tik. Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh t'ayin: Ixik, b'ikel a sat t'a ha ha' skuch Siloé, xchi winh t'ayin. Ix b'at in b'ikaneli. Icha chi' ix aj sb'o wilani, xchi winh.
--¿B'ajtil ayek' winh tikne'ik? xchi heb' winh. --Ma chekel, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix ik'jib'at winh t'a yichanh heb' winh fariseo.
Ha t'a sk'uhal ik'oj ip, hata' ix b'o yilan winh yuj Jesús yet' lum sok'om ix sb'o chi'.

Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'an heb' winh fariseo chi' t'a winh: --¿Tas wal ix aj sb'o hilani? xchi heb' winh. --Ha Jesús ix b'o'ani. Ix sukoch jab' lum sok'om t'a yol in sat tik. Ixlajwi chi', ix in schekanb'at in b'ikeli. Yuj chi' wach'xo wilan tikne'ik, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ay jaywanh heb' winh ix halan t'a winh: --Ha jun winh chi', manh yikoklaj Dios yaj winh, yujto max sk'anab'ajej sk'uhal ik'oj ip winh, xchi heb' winh. Palta ix laj yalan juntzanhxo heb' winh: --Tato chuk winh, ¿tom syal sch'oxan juntzanh satub'tak winh? xchi heb' winh. Yuj chi' chapoj ix aj heb' winh.

Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'an heb' winh t'a jun winh ix b'o yilan chi': --Ha hachxo tik, ¿tas tzutej a na'an yuj winh ixb'o'an a sat tik? xchi heb' t'a winh. --Ha in tik tzin na'a to schekab' Dios yaj winh, xchi winh.
Palta haxo heb' winh aj Judea chi', max schalaj yab' heb' winh, tato toto ix b'o yilan winh. Ha sna'an heb' winh to toxonton wach' yilan winh. Yuj chi' ix awtaj smam snun winh.
Ix k'anb'aj t'a heb': --¿Eyune' am jun winh tik? Palta to tzeyala' to max yaltaxon yilan winh. Tato icha chi', ¿tas wal ix aj sb'o yilan winh? xchi heb' t'a smam snun winh chi'.
--Ha jun winh tik, kik winh. Toxonton max yal yilan winh.

Palta manh kojtakok, tas am ix aj sb'o yilan winh. Manh kojtakok, mach am ixb'o'an sat winh tik. Ina ayxo sk'inal winh. ¿Tas yuj manhok t'a winh tze k'anb'ej eyab'i? Ha winh syal yalan t'ayex, tas ix aj sb'o sat winh chi', xchi heb'.

Icha chi' ix yutej heb' yalani, yujto xiw heb' yalan yuj heb' winh yajal t'a skal heb' aj Judea chi'. Yujto toxo ix yal heb' winh yajal chi': Tato ay heb' ol alanok to a Jesús haton Cristo, ol ko pechel heb' t'a yoltak spatil culto, xchi heb' winh.
Yuj chi', anhej jab' tik ix yal smam snun winh: Ina ayxo sk'inal winh. ¿Tas yuj manhok t'a winh tze k'anb'ej eyab'i? xchinhej heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix awtajxikot winh, ix yalan heb' t'a winh: --Wal yel tzach lolon t'a yichanh Dios. Yujto kojtak a onh tik to te chuk jun winh ixb'o'an a sat tzal chi', xchi heb' winh.
--Ha in tik, manh wojtakok tato chuk winh, mato ma'ay. Max yal-laj walani. Anhej tas wojtak: Ha t'a yalanhtaxo, max yal wilani, palta a tikne'ik tzaxo wila', xchi winh.
--Palta ¿tas wal ix ach yutej winh? ¿Chajwaltil ix yutej winh sb'o'an a sat tik? xchi heb' winh t'a winh.
--Toxo ix wala', palta max he cha eyab' t'ayin. ¿Tas yuj he gana tze k'anb'ej eyab' t'ayin junelxo? ¿Tom he gana tzex och pax sk'ayb'umok winh? xchi winh t'a heb' winh aj Judea chi'.
Ayik ix yab'an juntzanh chi' heb' winh, ix te b'uchji winh yuj heb' winh. Ix yalan heb' winh: --Ha ach tik, sk'ayb'um ach ton jun winh chi'. Xal onh tik, sk'ayb'um onh Moisés.
Kojtak to yalnakkan slolonel Dios t'a winhaj Moisés chi'. Palta a jun winh chi', manh kojtakok mach ak'jinak yopisio winh, xchi heb' winh.
--E... ¿jantak am b'i'an? Ha ex tik tzeyala' to manh eyojtakok mach ak'jinak yopisio winh, palta ina ix b'o wilan yuj winh.
Kojtak to ha Dios max ab'an slesal heb' chuk sk'ulej. Anhej heb' syal sb'a t'ay, heb' sk'anab'ajan tas syala', anhej yik heb' syab'i.
Manta b'aj skab' sb'o sat junok max yaltaxon yilani.
K'inalok manhok Dios ix chekankot Jesús chi', tekan malaj jab'ok tas syal yuj, xchi winh.
--Ha ach tik, te chuk ach yiktax ach alji. ¿A hachxo ijan tzonh a k'ayb'ej? xchi heb' winh. Yuj chi' ix spechelta winh heb' winh t'a spatil culto chi'.

Haxo ix yab'an Jesús to ix pechji'el winh ix b'oxi sat chi', yuj chi' ix sayji'ek' winh yuj. Haxo yik ix ilchaj winh yuj, ix yalan t'a winh: --¿Tzam ak'och jun Ak'b'ilkot yuj Dios yoch Animail t'a a k'o'ol? xchi t'a winh.
--Mamin, al t'ayin mach jun chi', yik ol wak'och t'a in k'o'ol, xchi winh.
--Toxo ix ila'. Ha in ton wan walan t'ayach, xchi t'a winh.
Ixlajwi yalan jun chi' Jesús, ix em kumnaj winh t'a yichanh. Ix yalan winh t'ay: --Mamin, tzach wak'och t'a in k'o'ol, xchi winh.

Ix yalanxi Jesús t'a winh: --Yuj sb'o heb' anima wu'uj in ja t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, yujto ay heb' max yal-laj yilan yik Dios tikne'ik, palta wu'uj ichato ol jakwok sat heb'. Ay pax nanhalxo heb' ichato syal yilan yik Dios sna'ani, palta a heb' chi', wu'uj ichato ol juwokb'at sat heb', xchi Jesús.
Ay jaywanh heb' winh fariseo ayek' ta'. Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' heb' winh, ix yalan heb' winh t'a Jesús: --¿Tom tza na to max uji kilan yik Dios? xchi heb' winh.

--Oktom snachajel eyu'uj to max yal eyilan yik Dios chi'. Tato icha chi', max am kan he mul t'a eyib'anh. Palta ina tzeyala' to syal eyilan yik Dios chi', yuj chi' ol kannhej he mul chi' t'a eyib'anh.
K'inalok ay junok te' makte' kalnel tikne'ik, ta ay junok winh tz'och t'a yol te', palta tato manhok t'a sti' te' tz'och winh, wal yel elk'um winh syal chi'.
Haxo winh tz'och t'a sti' te' smakte' nok' kalnel chi', haton winh chi' stanhwumal nok'.

Haxo winh swaymitan nok' kalnel chi', a winh sjakan te' makte' chi' t'a winh stanhwumal nok' chi'. Haxo nok' kalnel chi', k'aynak nok' yet' winh stanhwumal chi'. Yojtak sb'i junjun nok' winh. Ha winh sjakanelta nok'.
Slajwi sjakanelta nok' skalnel winh chi', sb'ab'laj winh yuj nok', tz'och tzak'an nok' yuj winh, yujto k'aynak nok' yet' winh.
Palta k'inalok ay junok winh manh k'aynakok nok' yet'ok, tonhej tz'el lemnaj nok' t'a winh, yujto manh ojtakab'ilok sjaj winh yuj nok', xchi Jesús t'a heb' winh fariseo chi'.
Ha jun ch'oxnab'il ix yal Jesús chi', maj nachajel-laj yuj heb' winh tas syalelk'ochi.
Ix yalanxi Jesús t'a heb' winh: --Wal yel swal t'ayex, icha yaj sti' te' smakte' nok' kalnel, icha chi' waji.

Ay heb' ix b'ab'laj ja t'ayex ayik manto in jawok, niwanok yalnakoch sb'a heb' kolwajumal. Icha junok elk'um tz'och t'a te' makte', icha chi' yaj heb' smasanil. Palta haxo heb' yik Dios, max yak'och spensar heb' t'a heb'.
Ha in tik, lajan in yet' sti' te' makte' chi'. Ha heb' tz'och t'ayin, ol kolchaj heb'. Icha nok' kalnel tz'och t'a yol smakte', tz'elxita nok', sb'at wa nok', icha chi' yaj heb'.
Ay heb' icha junok elk'um sjawi, syelk'al milan nok' kalnel chi' heb'. Palta a in tik, ix in ja wak' sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej, yik wach' te niwan swach'k'olal Dios ol scha heb'.
Ha in tik, lajan in yet' junok tanhwum kalnel te wach'. Ha junok tanhwum kalnel wach' chi', sb'ek sb'a scham yuj nok' skalnel chi'.

Ay b'aj tonhej stupji junok winh stanhwan nok' kalnel, manh toxonok tanhwum kalnel winh, manh yikok nok' winh. Tato sk'och nok' okes t'a nok', syaktejkan nok' kalnel chi' winh sch'okoj, sb'at winh elelal, yujto manh yikok nok' winh. Haxo nok' okes chi' sja juknajok, schi'anb'at nok' kalnel chi', saklemkanb'at nok'.
Tz'el lemnaj winh, yujto majan yaj winh, yujto manh yikok nok' winh, malaj tz'och nok' t'a winh.

Ha in tik, lajan in yet' junok tanhwum kalnel te wach'. Ha heb' wiko', ichato in kalnel yaj heb'. Ha in Mam yojtak in. Hanhejtona' in, wojtak pax in Mam chi'. Icha wojtak in b'a yet' in Mam chi', icha pax chi' wojtak in b'a yet' heb' wik chi'. B'ekan in wak'an cham in b'a yuj heb'.

Ay pax juntzanhxo heb' ol in ak'anoch t'a sk'o'ol, palta manh ketisraeloklaj heb'. Yowalil ol in molb'ejkot heb'. Ha heb' chi', ol in sk'anab'ajej heb'. Junnhej ol aj heb' smasanil, a in ol in tanhwej heb'.
Xajan in yuj in Mam, yujto b'ekan in k'o'ol in chami yik ol in pitzwokxi.

Ha in tik, b'ekan in k'ol in chami, yujto icha chi' in gana. Malaj mach tz'ik'anek' in k 'inal tik. Ha in swala' to tzin chami, hanhejtona' in swala' to tzin pitzwixi, yujto icha chi' yaj yalankan jun scheknab'il in Mam t'ayin, xchi Jesús t'a heb' winh.
Ayik ix yalan juntzanh tik, ix laj spojan sb'a heb' aj Judea chi' junelxo yuj tas ix yal chi'.
Ay nanhal heb' ix halani: --¿Tas yuj tzeyak'och he chikin t'a tas syal jun winh tik? Ina ayoch jun enemigo t'a winh, yuj chi' aykot t'a sjolom winh, xchi heb'.
Palta ay nanhalxo heb' ix halani: --Tato ayoch junok enemigo t'a winh, ¿tom syal yalan winh icha chi'? Ha junok enemigo, ¿tom syal sb'o'an sat junok mach max yaltaxon yilani? xchi heb'.
Ha t'a jun pekti' ix uji jun tik, haton t'a stiempo'al si'ik, stiempo'al pax yoch sk'inhal stemplo Dios t'a Jerusalén.
Haxo Jesús wan sb'eyek' t'a jun stenta'il sti' yamak'il templo chi' skuch yik Salomón.
Haxo heb' aj Judea ayek' ta', ix och hoyan heb' t'a spatik Jesús. Ix yalan heb': --¿B'ak'inhto ol al sjichanil t'ayonh? Tato yel Cristo ach, al t'ayonh tikne'ik, xchi heb' t'ay.

Yuj chi' ix tak'wi t'a heb': --Ina toxo ix wal t'ayex, palta max in eyak'och t'a he k'o'ol. Ha juntzanh satub'tak tzin ch'oxo', yujnhej spoder in Mam tzin ch'oxo'. Yujnhej juntzanh chi' scheklaji mach in.
Palta a ex tik, max in eyak'och t'a he k'o'ol, yujto manh ex wikok icha walnak t'ayex junel.
Ha heb' wiko', syak'och schikin heb' t'ayin. Ha inxo tik, wojtak heb'. Icha nok' kalnel tz'och tzak'an yuj stanhwumal, icha chi' tz'ajoch tzak'an heb' wu'uj.
Ha in swak' sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej. Yuj chi', manhxa b'ak'inh ol satel heb'. Malaj mach syal yik'anel heb' t'a yol in k'ab'.
Ha in Mam, te niwan yelk'och t'a yichanh smasanil. Ha ix ak'an heb' t'ayin. Malaj mach syal yik'anel heb' t'a yol sk'ab' in Mam chi'.
Ha in tik, lajan in yet' ko Mam Dios, yujto junnhej waj yet'ok, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Ix laj sik'ancha'anh k'e'en k'e'en heb' yik sjulancham heb' yalani.
Palta ix yalanxi Jesús t'a heb': --Tzijtum tas wach' ix in k'ulej t'a he kal yuj spoder in Mam. ¿Tas yuj junok ijan tzin he julchamok? xchi t'a heb'.
--Manh yujok junok wach' ix a k'ulej tzach ko julchamok, palta yujnhej to tzach b'uchwaj t'a Dios. Ha ach tik anima achnhej, palta ina tzaloch a b'a Diosal, xchi heb'.
Yuj chi' ix yalanxi t'a heb': --Ha t'a ch'anh ley aykan t'ayonh tz'ib'ab'ilkani to ha Dios alannak: Junjun ex, Dios ex, xchi t'a ley chi'.
Kojtak to a tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a Slolonel Dios chi', max yal sko mak'ek'i. Ha heb' ab'annak slolonel chi', alchajnak heb' diosal.
Okxom in tik, ha Dios sik'jinak in eli, ix in schekankot t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Yuj chi', ¿tas yuj tzeyala' to tzin b'uchwaj t'a Dios, ayik ix walani to Yuninal in Dios?
Tato max in k'ulej icha tas sk'ulej in Mam chi', manh in eyak'och t'a he k'o'ol.

Palta a in tik, yel wan in k'ulan icha sk'ulej in Mam chi'. Yuj chi', wach'chom max eyak'och t'a he k'o'ol tas swala', palta ak'ek in och t'a he k'o'ol yuj juntzanh tzin k'ulej tik, yik ol nachajel eyu'uj to ayoch ko Mam Dios t'ayin, ayin pax och t'ay, xchi Jesús chi' t'a heb'.
Yuj chi' ix yak'lej heb' syaman junelxo, palta ix skol sb'a t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix k'axpajxikan ek' t'a sk'axepal ha' Jordán. Haxo b'aj yak'nak bautizar heb' anima winhaj Juan ix aji.
Tzijtum anima ix k'och ta'. Ix laj yalan heb': --Ha winhaj Juan, malaj b'aj ix sch'ox junok tas satub'tak winh, palta jantaknhej tas ix yal winh yuj Jesús tik, te yel, xchi heb'.
Ha t'a jun lugar chi', tzijtum heb' ix ak'anoch Jesús t'a sk'o'ol.
Ay jun winh t'a chonhab' Betania skuchan Lázaro, te pena'ay winh. Hata' pax kajan chawanh heb' ix yanab' winh, jun ix skuch María, haxo junxo ix, Marta sb'i ix.
Ha ix María chi' sukjinakek' jun yal suk'uk'i sjab' t'a yok Jesús Kajal, haxo yet' xil sjolom ix suknak takjok. Ix pena'ayax winhaj Lázaro chi'.
Yuj chi', ix yak'kot sti' heb' ix t'a Jesús, ix yalankot heb' ix icha tik: --Mamin, a winh te xajan u'uj, pena'ay winh, xchikot heb' ix.

Ayik ix yab'an Jesús tas ix yalkot heb' ix chi', ix yalan icha tik: --Ha jun ilya chi', manh ol chamlaj winh yuj t'a junelnhej. Ix yamchaj winh yuj jun yab'il chi' yik ol sch'ox Dios to te niwan yelk'ochi, yik scheklajpaxeli to te niwan welk'och a in Yuninal in Dios tik, xchi Jesús.
Te xajan winhaj Lázaro chi', ix María yet' ix Marta yuj Jesús chi'.
Ayik ix yab'an Jesús chi' to te pena'ay winh, maj b'atlaj t'a elanhchamel. Chab'to k'uhal ix kan b'aj ayek' chi'.
Haxo yik ix k'och sk'uhal sb'at chi' jun, ix yalan t'a heb' sk'ayb'um: --Koyek t'a yol yik Judea junelxo, xchi t'a heb'.
Ix yalan heb' t'ay: --Ach ko k'ayb'umal, ina ijan sjulnak ach cham heb' aj Judea chi' jun, ¿tom tzach b'atxi? xchi heb'.
Ix yalanxi t'a heb': --Kojtak to lajchawe' hora tzek' t'a junjun k'u. Tato tzonh b'eyek' t'a k'uhalil, manh komonok tzonh telwi, yujto sakk'inal.
Palta a heb' sb'eyek' t'ak'walil, skomon telwi heb', yujto malaj sakil k'inal t'a heb', xchi Jesús.
Ixlajwi yalan jun chi', ix yalanpax yuj winhaj Lázaro: --Ha winh ko wach' k'o'ol chi', tonhej sway winh. Palta ol b'at in pitzel swayanh winh, xchi t'a heb'.
--Mamin, tato tonhej sway winh, tekan ol b'oxok sk'ol winh, xchi heb' sk'ayb'um chi' t'ay.
Ayik ix yalan Jesús to sway winhaj Lázaro chi', syalelk'ochi to chamnakxo winh. Palta a sna'an heb' tonhej sway winh.
Yuj chi', tojol ix yutej yalan t'a heb': --Toxo ix cham winh.
Ha tikne'ik tzin tzalaji, yujto manh in ayokek' ta' ix cham winh, yik ol in eyak'och t'a he k'o'ol. Yuj chi' koyek b'at kilek, xchi t'a heb'.
Haxo winhaj Tomás, jun winh tz'alji Tioxal, ix yal winh t'a heb' yetk'ayb'umal chi': --Koyek, b'at kak'ekcham ko b'a yet'ok, xchi winh.
Haxo yik ix k'och heb', ix yab'an heb' to oxjitax ix mukchaj winhaj Lázaro chi'.
Ha chonhab' Betania b'aj ay winh chi', t'a slak'anil Jerusalén ay. Ay am nanhalok legua skal.
Yuj chi', tzijtum heb' israel aj Jerusalén chi' xit' niwanan sk'o'ol ix María yet' ix Marta yuj winh snulej heb' ix, ix cham chi'.
Ayik ix yab'an ix Marta to wan sk'och Jesús, ix ja ix scha'a. Haxo ix María aykan ix t'a yol pat.
Ix yalan ix Marta chi' t'a Jesús icha tik: --Mamin, ayokach ek'laj t'a tik ayik ix cham winh in nulej chi', tekan maj chamlaj winh.
Palta a tikne'ik, wojtak yalnhej tas ol a k'an t'a Dios, A' ol ak'an t'ayach, xchi ix t'ay.
--Ha winh a nulej chi' ol pitzwokxi winh, xchi Jesús chi' t'a ix.
--Yel toni, wojtak to ol pitzwokxi winh, palta hato t'a slajwub' k'uhal ayik ol pitzwokxi heb' chamnak, xchi ix t'ay.
--Ha in tik, swak' pitzwokxi heb' chamnak, aj k 'inal in. Ha mach tzin ak'anoch t'a sk'o'ol, wach'chom ol chamok, palta ol pitzwokxi.
Ha mach pitzanto tzin yak'anoch t'a sk'o'ol, manhxa b'ak'inh ol chamok. ¿Tzam ak'och jun tik t'a a k'o'ol? xchi Jesús t'a ix.
--I'... Mamin, swak'och t'a in k'o'ol to Cristo ach, Yuninal ach Dios. Ha ach tik tanhwab'il a ja t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, xchi ix t'ay.
Ixlajwi yalan jun chi' ix Marta chi', ix pax ix. Ix b'at ix yawtejkot ix María ix snulej chi'. Ix sajanoch ix t'a schikin ix t'a elk'altak: --Ix ja ko k'ayb'umal, tzach yawtej, xchi ix.
Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' ix María chi', ix k'e juknaj ix. Ix b'at ix b'aj ayek' Jesús chi',
yujto manto och t'a yol jun chonhab' chi'. Hanheja' ayek' b'aj xit' scha ix Marta chi'.

Palta ay heb' aj Judea ayek' yet' ix t'a yol spat chi'. Ayek' heb' sniwanej sk'ol ix. Haxo ix yilan heb', ix k'e juknaj ix, ix b'at lemnaj ix, tzak'anxonhej ix b'at heb' yuj ix, yujto a sna'an heb' to sb'at ok' ix b'aj mukan winh snulej chi'.
Ayik ix k'och ix b'aj aykan Jesús chi', ix em kumnaj ix t'a yichanh, ix yalan ix t'ay: --Mamin, ayokach ek'laj t'a tik a ix cham winh in nulej chi', tekan maj chamlaj winh, xchi ix.
Ayik ix yilan Jesús to tz'ok' ix, tz'ok' pax heb' aj Judea ix k'och yet' ix, ix te kusk'e yet' heb'.
Ix sk'anb'an t'a heb' ix: --¿B'ajtil ix he mukem winh? xchi t'a heb' ix. --Mamin, koyek b'at kileknab'i, xchi heb' ix.
Ix ok' Jesús.
Haxo heb' aj Judea ayek' chi' ta', ix laj yalan heb': --Te xajan winh yuj, xchi heb'.
Ay pax heb' ix laj halani: --Ha Jesús tik, ha' b'ojinakxi sat jun winh max yaltaxon yilani. ¿Tom maj yal ix kolwaj t'a winhaj Lázaro tik, yik wach' maj chamlaj winh? xchi heb'.
Te kusnak Jesús ayik ix k'och b'aj mukan winhaj Lázaro chi'. Ha t'a yol jun k'e'en k'e'en joyb'ilel yo'ol, hata' ayoch sniwanil winh. Aypaxoch jun k'e'en k'e'en smakulok sti' k'e'en.
--Ik'ekel k'e'en smakul tik, xchi Jesús. Haxo ix Marta ix halan t'ay: --Mamin, oxjitax cham winh, ayxomlaj sjab' winh tikne'ik, xchi ix.
Toxo ix wal t'ayach, tato tzin ak'och t'a a k'o'ol, ol il spoder Dios, xchi t'a ix.
Ichato chi' ix yik'anel k'e'en smakul chi' heb' b'aj ayoch sniwanil winh chi'. Ix k'e k'elan Jesús t'a satcha'anh, ix yalani: --Mamin, swak' yuj diosal t'ayach yujto ix ab' tas swala'.
Wojtaktaxoni, masanil tiempo tzab' tas swala'. Palta yuj heb' anima tik swal juntzanh tik t'ayach, yik wach' ol yak'och heb' t'a sk'o'ol to a ach a cheknak in koti, xchi Jesús.
Ixlajwi yalan juntzanh chi', te cha'anh ix yala': --Lázaro, elanhkoti, xchi.

Haxo winh chamnak chi', ix elta winh, b'ak'b'il yok winh yet' sk'ab' t'a jun k'apak, b'ak'b'il pax snanhal sat winh yet' junxo k'apak. Ix yalanxi Jesús: --Xuyekel juntzanh k'apak ayoch tik t'a winh, tzeyaktanel winh, xchi.
Haxo heb' aj Judea ajun yet' ix María chi', ayik ix yilan heb' tas ix sk'ulej Jesús chi', tzijtum heb' ix ak'anoch t'a sk'o'ol.
Palta ay juntzanhxo heb' ix b'at halan yab' heb' winh fariseo tas ix yutej sb'a Jesús chi'.

Haxo heb' winh fariseo chi' yet' heb' winh sat sacerdote, ix slajti'ej sb'a heb' winh yet' heb' winh sat yajal. Ix laj yalan heb' winh icha tik: --¿Tas skutejek winh tze na'a? Yujto tzijtum wal juntzanh satub'tak sch'ox winh.

Tato tonhej skiloch winh tikne'ik, masanil heb' ketchonhab' ol ak'anoch winh t'a sk'o'ol. Haxo heb' winh yajal t'a Roma ol ul smak'poj jun stemplo Dios tik heb' winh, ol ul onh satanel heb' winh ko masanil, xchi heb' winh.
Palta ay jun winh skuchan Caifás, haton winh sat sacerdote t'a jun ab'il chi'. Ha winh ix halan t'a heb' winh: --Ha ex tik, malaj jab'ok he pensar.
Max nachajel jab'ok eyu'uj, más wach' t'ayonh tato scham jun winh chi' sk'exulok heb' anima smasanil. Tato icha chi', manh ol onh satel ko masanil, xchi winh.

Ha winhaj Caifás chi', manhok t'a yol yik winh ix yal jun chi', palta yujto sat sacerdote yaj winh t'a jun ab'il chi', yuj chi' ha Dios ix ak'an yal winh to ol cham Jesús sk'exulok heb' israel smasanil.
