Ha schamel chi', manh yujoknhej heb' israel chi', palta yuj pax smolb'anxi heb' yuninal Dios sakleminak yajkanb'ati, yik junxonhej tz'aj heb'.
Yuj chi', atax t'a jun k'u chi' ix och ijan heb' winh sna'an tas ol yutok smilancham Jesús.
Yuj chi' maxtzak ek' Jesús t'a skal heb' aj Judea chi'. Ix el t'a jun lugar chi'. Ix b'at t'a jun chonhab' skuchan Efraín ay t'a sti' jun lum takinh lu'um. Hata' ix kan yet' heb' sk'ayb'um.

Ayik wan sja stiempo'al jun k'inh tz'ochi yik sna'ankot heb' israel tas aj yelnakkot heb' smam yicham heb' t'a Egipto, tzijtum wal heb' najat ix laj koti, ix laj k'och heb' t'a Jerusalén. Ayik manto yamchajoch jun k'inh chi', ix k'och heb' ta' yik sb'o sb'a heb' icha yalan ley.
Ayik ayek' heb' ta', tzijtum wal heb' ix ek' sayanek' Jesús, haxo t'a yamak'il templo ix laj yal heb': --¿Tas tze na'a? ¿Ol am ja Jesús t'a k'inh tik, mato ma'ay? xchi heb'.

Haxo heb' winh fariseo yet' heb' winh sat sacerdote ix ak'anelta jun ab'ix tz'alan icha tik: Tato ay b'aj tzeyil Jesús, tzul eyal t'ayonh, xchi heb' winh. Icha chi' ix yutej heb' winh yalani, yujto snib'ej heb' winh syak'och Jesús t'a preso.
Ob'ixxonhej yoch k'inh t'a Jerusalén yik sna'ankot heb' israel tas aj yelnakkot heb' smam yicham heb' t'a Egipto, ix k'ochxi Jesús t'a Betania, b'aj kajan winhaj Lázaro, haton winh ix pitzwixi yuj.
Ayik ix k'och Jesús chi' ta', ix ak'ji'och jun niwan wa'el yuj heb' yuj Jesús. Ix wa winhaj Lázaro yet' heb'. Ha ix Marta ix k'atk'ankot heb'.

Haxo ix María, yet'nak nanhal litro yal suk'uk'i sjab' ix, skuch nardo. Ha jun chi' te caro stojol. Haxo ix k'och ix, ix stob'anoch ix t'a yok Jesús. Ixlajwi chi' ix sukan takjok ix t'a xil sjolom. Ix el numan sjab' t'a yol pat chi'.
Ay jun winh sk'ayb'um Jesús skuchan Judas aj Queriot yuninal winhaj Simón, haton winh ol ak'anoch Jesús t'a yol sk'ab' chamel. Ix yal winh icha tik:
--Ha jun suk'uk'i sjab' tik, ay am junok 300 denario stojol. Oktom ix ko chonho', haxo stojol chi' skak' t'a heb' meb'a', niwanok xchi winh.
Palta yes winh. Max snalaj jab'ok heb' meb'a' chi' winh. Yujto sik'um tumin yaj winh, yuj chi' snib'ej winh sik' stojol chi', yik wach' syik'kanel jab'ok yik winh, yujto elk'um winh.
Haxo ix yalan Jesús t'a winh: --Manh a tzuntzej ix, yujto a jun suk'uk'i sjab' tik, sik'b'ilb'at yuj ix yik wach' listaxo yaj in mukilok.
Haxo heb' meb'a' tzal chi', aynhejek' heb' heyet'ok. Ha inxo tik, manh masanilok tiempo ayinek' heyet'ok, xchi t'a winh.

Tzijtum heb' israel ix ab'ani to ayek' Jesús t'a Betania. Yuj chi' ix b'at heb' yila'. Manhoknhej Jesús snib'ej heb' syila'. Snib'ej pax heb' syil winhaj Lázaro, yujto ix pitzwixi winh t'a skal heb' chamnak yuj Jesús.

Yuj winhaj Lázaro chi', tzijtum heb' ix ak'anoch Jesús t'a sk'o'ol. Maxtzak yak'och spensar heb' t'a heb' winh sacerdote. Yuj chi' ix slajti'ej sb'a heb' winh sat sacerdote chi' tas syutej heb' winh smilanpaxcham winhaj Lázaro chi'.
Tzijtum anima ix k'och t'a Jerusalén yuj sk'inh heb' israel yik snajikoti tas aj yelnakkot heb' smam yicham heb' t'a Egipto. Haxo t'a junxo k'u ix yab'an heb' to wan sk'och Jesús ta'.

Yuj chi', tzijtum heb' ix laj tzepan el xil anh k'ib'. Ix yik'anb'at heb', ix b'at scha'an Jesús heb'. Ix awaj cha'anh heb' icha tik: Yuj wal Dios. Kalek wach' lolonel t'a jun chekb'ilkot yuj Dios Kajal. Kalek wach' lolonel t'a ko reyal a onh israel onh tik, xchi heb'.
Haxo Jesús ix ilchaj jun nok' yune' b'uru yuj. Ix k'e t'a yib'anh nok' icha yaj stz'ib'chajkan t'a Slolonel Dios icha tik:
Ex aj Sion, manh ex xiwok. Ileknab' sjawi he reyal. Ayk'e t'a yib'anh jun nok' b'uru, xchi.

Ha juntzanh tik, maj nachajel-laj yuj heb' sk'ayb'um Jesús t'a jun k'u chi'. Hato yik ix ik'jik'e t'a satcha'anh, hato ta' ix snakot heb' to a yab'ixal tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a Slolonel Dios, ix elk'och icha yajkani.
Ha juntzanh heb' ayek' yet' Jesús ayik ix yawtanelta winhaj Lázaro b'aj mukb'il yik ix pitzwixi winh, ix laj yalel heb' tas ix yil heb' chi'.
Yuj chi' ix b'at heb' anima scha Jesús, yujto ix laj yab' yab'ixal jun satub'tak ix sk'ulej chi' heb'.
Ix laj yalan heb' winh fariseo icha tik: --Manhxa tas wach' kutanek tikne'ik. Ileknab' heb' anima, ix laj och heb' masanil yet' winh, xchi heb' winh.
Ay juntzanh heb' griego ix k'och t'a Jerusalén t'a jun k'inh chi', yik b'at yak'anem sb'a heb' t'a Dios.
Ix k'och heb' t'a winhaj Felipe aj Betsaida t'a yol yik Galilea. Ix yalan heb' t'a winh: --Mamin, ko gana skil Jesús, xchi heb'.
Ix b'at winhaj Felipe chi' yal t'a winhaj Andrés, junnhej ix b'at heb' winh schawanhil, ix b'at yalan heb' winh t'a Jesús chi'.
Ix yalan t'a heb' winh: --Ha in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch anima'il tik, a tikne'ik wan sk'och yora'il scheklajeli to te niwan welk'ochi.
Wal yel swal t'ayex, k'inalok ay junok inhat trigo skan pitan t'a sat lu'um, skannhej icha chi'. Palta tato smukji, ichato schami, haxo yik sjawi, niwan sat syak'a'.
Ha mach anhej sk'inal ay yelk'och t'a sat, ol satel sk'inal chi'. Haxo mach malaj yelk'och sk'inal t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik t'a sat, haton jun chi' ol scha sk'inal t'a junelnhej.

Tato ay heb' snib'ej tz'och in chekab'ok, ochokab' tzak'an heb' wu'uj. Ha heb' in chekab' chi', ol aj heb' wet' b'aj ayin ek'i. Tato ay heb' tz'och in chekab'ok, haxo in Mam ol ch'oxanok to niwan yelk'och heb' t'a sat, xchi Jesús.

Ha tikne'ik, te pitz'anoch kusk'olal t'a in pixan. ¿Tas ol wutok walani? ¿Tom ol wal icha tik t'a Dios: Mamin, kolinelta t'a yol sk'ab' jun yahelal sja t'a wib'anh tik, tom xin chi? Palta yujnhej wal jun tik yak'nak in koti.

Mamin, cheklajokab'eli to niwan elk'ochi, xchi Jesús. Ixlajwi chi', ix lolonemta jun t'a satcha'anh, ix yalan icha tik: --Toxo ix in ch'oxeli to niwan welk'ochi, haxo tikne'ik ol in ch'oxel junelxo, xchi.
Haxo heb' anima ayek' ta', ayik ix yab'an jun chi' heb', ix yalan heb' to ix k'anh k'u. Ay juntzanhxo heb' ix halani: --Tekan a junok ángel ix lolonemta t'a Jesús tik, xchi heb'.
Yuj chi' ix yal Jesús t'a heb': --Manh wujok ix alji'emta juntzanh tik, palta eyu'uj.
Ha tikne'ik, ol ch'olb'itaj tas yaj heb' ay t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Haxo winh tz'ak'an mandar jun yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ol pechjokel winh.
Ha in tik, ayik ol in ik'jokk'e t'a cha'anh, ol wik'kot masanil heb' anima t'ayin, xchi Jesús.
Icha chi' ix yutej yalani chajtil ol aj schami.

Haxo ix yalan heb' anima t'ay: --Ha t'a ley aykan t'ayonh, hata' ix kab'i to a Cristo aynhejek' t'a masanil tiempo. Yuj chi', ¿tas yuj tzala' to a jun Ak'b'ilkot yuj Dios yoch anima'il, yowalil ol ik'jokk'e t'a cha'anh? ¿Mach jun Ak'b'ilkot tzal chi'? xchi heb' t'ay.

Yuj chi' ix yal t'a heb': --Ha in swak' sakil k'inal t'ayex, ayinek' t'a he kal tikne'ik, palta kenxonhej tiempo ayin ek'i. Tojolb'itejek he b'a yakb'an ayin to ek' jab'okxo heyet'ok. Tato ma'ay, ol somchajel he pensar. Icha junok mach sb'eyek' t'a k'ik' k'inal, max uji yilan b'aj sb'ati, icha chi' ol ex ajok.

Ha in tik, aj sakil k'inal in. Yuj chi', ak'ek in och t'a he k'o'ol yakb'an ayin to ek' heyet'ok, yik ol wak' sakil k'inal t'ayex t'a junelnhej, xchi Jesús t'a heb'. Ixlajwi yalan juntzanh chi', ix sb'esanel sb'a, ix sk'ub'anel sb'a t'a heb'.
Wach'chom tzijtum tas satub'tak ix sch'ox Jesús yil heb', palta malaj wal heb' ix ak'anoch t'a sk'o'ol.

Icha chi' ix aj yelk'och tas yalnakkan winhaj Isaías schekab' Dios. Haton jun tz'alan icha tik: Mamin Kajal, ¿tom ay mach tz'ak'anoch t'a sk'ol tas skaleli? ¿Tom ay mach snachajel yuj to a a poder scheklaj t'a jun ab'ix tik? xchi winh t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkan chi'.
Yuj chi' max yal-laj yak'anoch heb' t'a sk'o'ol. Hanheja' winhaj Isaías chi' aljinakxikan icha tik:

Ha Dios tz'ak'an heb' musansatil, swach' ak'an pitb'ok spensar heb', yik wach' max yil heb', max nachajel yuj heb', yik max k'exmaj spensar heb'. Yuj chi' ha Dios max kolan heb', xchi winhaj Isaías chi'.
Yalnak juntzanh tik winhaj Isaías chi', yujto ayokto yilannak stzikiki'al Jesús winh, yuj chi' haton yab'ixal yalnakkan winh.

Wach'chom yalnakkan winh icha chi', palta ay heb' israel ix ak'anoch Jesús t'a sk'o'ol. Tzijtum pax heb' yajal ix ak'anoch t'a sk'o'ol. Palta max sch'oxel-laj sb'a heb', yujto xiw heb' t'a heb' winh fariseo, talaj spechji'elta heb' t'a yol spatil culto.
Icha chi' ix yutej sb'a heb', yujto anhej t'a yichanh heb' anima snib'ej heb' ay yelk'ochi. Malaj tz'och t'a heb' tato ay yelk'och heb' t'a yichanh Dios.

Ayik manto sb'esel-laj sb'a Jesús t'a skal heb' anima chi', te cha'anh ix yal t'a skal heb': --Ab'ek jun swal tik t'ayex: Ha heb' tzin ak'anoch t'a sk'o'ol, manhok innhej tzin yak'och heb' t'a sk'o'ol. Ha in Mam chekjinak in kot syak'paxoch heb' t'a sk'o'ol.
Ha heb' tzin hilani, syil pax jun chekjinak in kot chi' heb'.
Ha in tik, ak'um in sakil k'inal. In jawi t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik yik wach' a heb' tzin ak'anoch t'a sk'o'ol, manhxo ayokek' heb' t'a k'ik' k'inal.

Ha heb' tz'ab'an in lolonel, palta max sk'anab'ajejlaj heb', manhok in laj ol wak'och t'a yib'anh heb', yujto manh yujok wak'anoch t'a eyib'anh, in ja t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, palta yuj wak'an he kolnab'il in jawi.

Ha heb' tzin patikaneli, heb' max cha'an pax yab' in lolonel, toxonton ayek' jun ol ak'anoch t'a yib'anh heb' chi', haton in lolonel swalkan tik. Yuj in lolonel tik, ol ak'jokoch t'a yib'anh heb' t'a slajwub' k'uhal.
Yujto a in tik, max in lolonlaj t'a yol wiko'. Ha in Mam chekjinak in koti, a alannak tas yowalil swala' yet' tas swutej walani.
Wojtak to yuj scheknab'il chi', syal he cha'an he k 'inal t'a junelnhej. Yuj chi', icha yaj yalan in Mam t'ayin, icha chi' swutej walan t'ayex, xchi Jesús.

K'ik'anokxo tz'och sk'inh heb' israel yik snajikoti tas aj yelnakkot heb' smam yicham heb' t'a Egipto, yojtakxo pax Jesús to toxo sja stiempo'al yaktankan jun yol yib'anhk'inal tik, haxo sk'ex chi' t'a ko Mam Dios. Ha heb' yikxo ay t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ix xajanejnhej heb'. Ix xajanejnhej pax heb' masanto t'a slajwub'.

Haxo winhaj Judas yuninal winhaj Simón aj Queriot, toxo ix och winh diablo t'a winh, yik wach' a winh tz'ak'anoch Jesús t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ay. Palta yojtak Jesús to a t'a Dios kotnak, hata' ol k'ochxok. Yojtak to a ko Mam Dios ak'jinakoch masanil tas t'a yol sk'ab'. Ayik wan swa yet' heb' sk'ayb'um, ix k'e linhan, ix skichanel jun kol spichul, ix stzek'anoch jun k'apak toalla t'a snanhal.
Ixlajwi chi' ix sekanem ha ha' t'a yol jun palangana, ix och ijan sb'ikanel yok heb' sk'ayb'um chi'. Haxo yet' k'apak toalla chi' ix suk takjok yok heb' chi'.
Haxo ijan ix sb'ikanel yok winhaj Simón Pedro, ix yalan winh t'ay: --Mamin, ¿tom ijan tza b'ikel wok tik a na'ani? xchi winh.
--Ha tikne'ik, maxto nachajel u'uj tas wan in k'ulan tik. k'ojank'olalto ol nachajel u'uj, xchi Jesús chi' t'a winh.
--Ma'ay, manh wal jab'ok ol wak' wok tik a b'ikeli, xchi winhaj Pedro chi'. --Tato max ak' in b'ikel jun, malaj halan ik wet'ok, xchi Jesús t'a winh.
--Tato icha chi' an Mamin, manhoknhej wok tik tza b'ikeli. B'ikel in k'ab', tza b'akanpaxel in jolom, xchi winhaj Pedro chi'.

Palta ix yalanxi Jesús: --K'inalok ay junok mach toto sb'ikel sb'a, manh yowalilok sb'ikchaj sniwanil smasanil. Anhej yok sb'ikchaji, yujto sakto sniwanil. Ha ex tik icha junok mach b'ikb'ilxo, icha chi' eyaji, yujto toxo ix tojolb'i he pensar. Palta manh he masanilok ix tojolb'i he pensar, xchi Jesús.
Yojtakxo mach jun ol ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' chamel, yuj chi' ix yala': Manh he masanilok ix tojolb'i he pensar, xchi.
Ixlajwi sb'ikan yok heb' chi', ix yak'anxi'och sk'apak. Ix emxi k'ojan yet' heb'. Ix yalanxi: --¿Tzam nachajel eyu'uj tas yuj icha tik tzex wutej?
Ha ex tik, tzin eyal he k'ayb'umok, eyajalok. Yel ton tzeyala'.
k'ayb'um in t'ayex. Yajal waj t'ayex. Palta ina ix in b'ikel eyok tik. Yuj chi' smoj icha chi' tzeyutej he b'a junjun ex.
Ix in ch'ox jun tik t'ayex, yik wach' icha tzex wutej tik, icha chi' ol eyutok he b'a junjun ex.
Wal yel swal t'ayex, malaj junok chekab' ek'al t'a yichanh spatrón. Icha pax chi' heb' chekab', malaj junok heb' ek'al t'a yichanh jun schekan chi'.
Tato snachajel juntzanh tik eyu'uj, tze k'anab'ajani, te wach' eyiko'.

Manh eyujok he masanil swal jun tik, yujto wojtakxo tas heyaj a ex sik'b'il exxo el wu'uj. Palta yowalil ol elk'och tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a Slolonel Dios b'aj syalkan icha tik: Ha winh swa wet'ok, a winh smeltzajoch ajk'olal t'ayin, xchi.
Ayokto swalankan juntzanh tik t'ayex, yik wach' ayik ol ja t'a wib'anh chi', ol eyak'och t'a he k'o'ol to a in ton Cristo in.
Wal yel swal t'ayex, a mach scha'an heb' in chekab', syalelk'ochi a in tzin scha heb'. Ha heb' tzin cha'an chi', scha pax jun chekjinak in kot heb', xchi Jesús.
Ixlajwi yalan juntzanh chi' Jesús, ix te och ilk'olal, ix yalani: --Wal yel swal t'ayex, ha t'a he kal tik ay jun winh ol in ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' chamel, xchi t'a heb' winh.
Haxo heb' winh sk'ayb'um chi', ix och k'eljab' heb' winh t'ay junjun, yujto manh yojtakok heb' winh mach jun syal chi'.
Ayik wan swa heb', a winh sk'ayb'um Jesús te xajanab'il yuj, ha t'a stz'ey ayek' winh.
Haxo winhaj Simón Pedro ix ak'an yechel t'a winh, yuj chi' tope sk'anb'ej winh t'a Jesús machtaxlaj jun syal chi'.
Yuj chi' ix swach' nitzanoch sb'a winh t'a stz'ey Jesús. Ix sk'anb'an winh t'ay: --Mamin, ¿mach jun tzal chi'? xchi winh.

--Ol in lab'ejem jab' ixim pan tik t'a skal yal vinagre, haxo jun winh b'aj ol wak'a', haton jun winh chi', xchi Jesús t'a winh. Ix lajwinhej yalan jun chi', ix slab'anem jab' ixim pan chi' t'a skal vinagre chi', ix yak'an t'a winhaj Judas yuninal winhaj Simón aj Queriot.
Ixlajwi scha'an jab' ixim pan chi' winh, ix wach' och winh Satanás t'a winh, ix yalan Jesús t'a winh: --Ha tas nab'il u'uj, k'ulej t'a elanhchamel, xchi t'a winh.
Haxo heb' winh ayoch yet' t'a te' mexa chi', malaj junok heb' winh ix nachajel yuj tas yuj icha chi' ix yal t'a winh.
Ha winhaj Judas chi', sik'um tumin yaj winh, yuj chi' ay heb' ix na'ani to syal Jesús chi' t'a winh yuj tas sman winh yuj k'inh chi', mato a jab'ok tumin chi' b'at yak' winh t'a heb' meb'a'.
Haxo winhaj Judas chi', ix lajwinhej swa'anb'at jun pan chi' winh, ix elta winh t'a skal heb'. Toxo ix k'ik'b'i.
Ixlajwi yelta winhaj Judas chi', ix yalan Jesús: --Ha tikne'ik, ol cheklajel sniwanil welk'och a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch anima'il tik. Ol in ch'oxpaxel sniwanil yelk'och Dios.
Tato ol in ch'oxel sniwanil yelk'ochi, haxo ol ch'oxanpaxel sniwanil welk'och t'a elanhchamel.
Ex xajanab'il wu'uj, kenxonhej tiempo ayinek' heyet'ok. Ol in he sayek'i, palta manto ol yal-laj he k'och b'aj ol in k'och chi', icha wutejnak walankan t'a heb' aj Judea.
Ay junxo ak' cheknab'il ol walkan t'ayex tikne'ik, to slaj he xajanej he b'a junjun ex. Icha tzex wutej ex in xajanan tik, icha chi' tzeyutej he xajanan he b'a.
Tato tze xajanej he b'a junjun ex, ol yojtakejel heb' anima smasanil to yel in k'ayb'um ex, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.

Haxo winhaj Simón Pedro ix k'anb'an t'ay: --Mamin, ¿b'ajwaltil ol ach k'och jun? xchi winh. --Ha b'aj ol in k'och chi', manh ol yal-laj a k'och wet' tikne'ik. k'ojank'olalto ol ach k'och wet' ta', xchi Jesús t'a winh.
--Palta Mamin, ¿tas yuj max yal in b'at et' tikne'ik jun? In b'eknakxo cham in b'a u'uj, xchi winhaj Pedro chi' t'ay.
--A... ¿tom yel tza b'ek a b'a a cham wu'uj? Wal yel swal t'ayach, ayik manto ok' nok' kaxlanh t'a jun ak'wal tik, oxel ol ik'el t'a ib'anh to manh in ojtakok, xchi Jesús t'a winh.
Ix yalanxi Jesús t'a heb' sk'ayb'um: --Manh eyak' somchaj he k'o'ol. Tzeyak'och Dios t'a he k'o'ol, tzin eyak'anpaxoch t'a he k'o'ol.
Ha b'aj ay in Mam, manh jantakok kajnub' ay. K'inalok tato malaj, tas am gana swal t'ayex to tzin b'at in b'o eyet'tal b'aj ol ex k'ochok.
Ol lajwok in b'o'an eyet'tal chi' ta', ol in jax junelxo. Haxo ul ex wik'an chi' wet'ok, yik wach' a b'aj ayinek' chi', hata' ol ex aj wet'ok.
Ha ex tik eyojtakxo b'aj ol in k'ochok. Eyojtak pax jun b'e b'aj ol in b'atok, xchi t'a heb'.
Haxo winhaj Tomás ix halan t'ay: --Palta Mamin, manh kojtakok b'ajtil tzach b'at chi'. Yuj chi', ¿tas ol kutok kojtakanel jun b'e chi'? xchi winh.
Ix yalan Jesús t'a winh: --Ha jun b'e swal tik, a in toni. Ha innhej syal ex wik'anb'at b'aj ay ko Mam Dios. Yelnhej swala'. Ak'um in k 'inal.
Yujto a ex tik eyojtak inxo, yuj chi' ol eyojtakejpaxel in Mam. Ha tikne'ik, eyojtakxo in Mam chi', yujto toxo ix heyila', xchi t'a heb'.
Haxo winhaj Felipe ix halan t'ay: --Mamin, ch'ox a Mam chi' kila'. k'okb'ilnhej chi', xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix yalanxi Jesús t'a winh: --Felipe, ina pekatax ayinek' heyet'ok, ¿tom manto in ojtakok? Ha heb' tzin hilani, syalelk'ochi wan yilan in Mam heb'. Yuj chi', ¿tas yuj tzato al t'ayin: Ch'ox a Mam chi' kila', xa chi?
¿Tom max ak'och t'a a k'o'ol to ayin och t'a in Mam, ay pax och t'ayin? Ha tas swal t'ayex, manh yolok wik swala', palta ha' ayoch t'ayin, a wan smunlaj wet'ok.
Hak'ekoch t'a he k'o'ol to junnhej waj yet' in Mam chi', junnhej pax yaj wet'ok. Tato max in eyak'och t'a he k'o'ol yuj tas swal tik, ak'ek in och t'a he k'o'ol yuj juntzanh satub'tak tzin ch'oxo'.

Wal yel swal t'ayex, a mach tzin ak'anoch t'a sk'o'ol, ol sb'o juntzanh munlajel tzin b'o tik. Ayto juntzanhxo ek'alto ol sb'o t'a yichanh juntzanh tzin b'o tik, yujto ol in paxk'e b'aj ay in Mam chi'.
Yalnhej tas ol he k'an t'a Dios t'a in b'i, ol ak'jok t'ayex. Icha pax chi' ol wutej a in Yuninal in Dios tik, yik wach' ol cheklajelta to te niwan yelk'och ko Mam Dios.
Yalnhej tas ol he k'an t'a Dios t'a in b'i, ol ak'jok t'ayex.
Tato tzin he xajanej, k'anab'ajejek in cheknab'il.
Ha in tik, ol in k'an t'a ko Mam, haxo ol ak'ankot junxo ol kolwaj heyet'ok, haton Yespíritu te yel syala'. Ha ol kan eyet' t'a masanil tiempo.

Ha heb' yik yol yib'anhk'inal tik, max yal-laj scha'an heb', yujto max yil-laj heb', manh ojtakab'ilok yuj heb'. Ha exxo tik, eyojtakxo Yespíritu chi', yujto aytaxon ek' heyet'ok. Ha ol ochkan kajan t'ayex t'a junelnhej.
Ha in tik, manh ol ex waktejkanlaj he ch'okoj, ol in jax t'ayex junelxo.
Kenxonhej tiempo'al, manhxo ol in yil-laj heb' manh wikok t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Ha exxo pax tik, ol in heyila'. Yujto pitzan innhej, pitzan ex pax t'a junelnhej.
Ha t'a jun k'uhal yik ol ochkan Espíritu t'ayex, hato ta' ol nachajel eyu'uj to ayin och t'a in Mam. Haxo snachajel chi' eyu'uj to ayex och t'ayin, ayin pax och t'ayex.

Ha heb' syak'och spensar t'a in cheknab'il, sk'anab'ajan heb', haton heb' chi' xajan in yuj. Ha heb' tzin xajanani, xajan pax heb' yuj in Mam. Ha in ol in xajanej heb', ol in ch'ox in b'a t'a heb', xchi Jesús.

Ay junxo sk'ayb'um winh skuch Judas, manhoklaj winh aj Queriot, a winh ix halani: --Mamin, ¿tas yuj haxonhej t'ayonh ol a ch'ox a b'a? ¿Tas yuj manhxo ol a ch'ox a b'a t'a heb' yik yol yib'anhk'inal tik? xchi winh t'a Jesús.
Yuj chi' ix yalxi Jesús chi': --Ha heb' xajan in yuj, sk'anab'ajej pax in lolonel heb'. Yuj chi' haxo in Mam ol xajanan heb'. Ha in yet' in Mam chi' ol onh ochkan kajan t'a heb'.
Haxo heb' max in xajanani, max sk'anab'ajej paxlaj heb' tas swala'. Ha juntzanh lolonel swal tik t'ayex, manh wikok, yik in Mam chekjinak in koti.
Swalkan juntzanh tik t'ayex yakb'an ayinto ek' heyet'ok.
Ha ko Mam Dios ol chekankot Yespíritu t'ayex in k'exulok. A' ol kolwaj heyet'ok, ol ex sk'ayb'an t'a masanil tastak. Ol yek he nakot jantaknhej tas walnakxokan t'ayex.
Ha tikne'ik, swak'kan in junk'olal t'ayex. Ha in junk'olal swak'kan t'ayex tik, manh lajanok icha junk'olal syak' heb' yik yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Manh eyak' somchajel he k'o'ol, manh ex xiwok.
Toxo ix wal eyab'i to ol in paxok, palta ol in jax t'ayex. Tato yel tzin he xajanej, tzex tzalaji, yujto ol in pax t'a ko Mam, yujto ek'alto t'a wichanh.
Ayokto swalankan juntzanh tik t'ayex, yik wach' ayik ol ujok jun swal tik, ol in he wach' ak'ejoch t'a he k'o'ol.
Manhxo niwanok tas swal t'ayex, yujto wanxo sja winh yajal yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Ha winh chi', malaj yalan yik winh t'ayin.
Palta tzin k'anab'ajej cheknab'il ix yak' ko Mam Dios t'ayin, yik wach' ol nachajel yuj heb' yik yol yib'anhk'inal tik to xajan wu'uj. Haxo tikne'ik, k'e'anhek wa'an, koyek, xchi Jesús.
Ix yalanpax Jesús t'a heb' sk'ayb'um: --Ha in tzin sch'ox jun te' nunal uwa wach'. Haxo jun tz'ak'enan te', a in Mam sch'oxo'.

Tato ay te' sk'ab' max satani, haxo ol tzepanel te'. Tato ay te' sk'ab' wach' satani, haxo ol ak'enan te' yik tzijtum sat te' syak'a'. Icha syutej yak'enan te' chi', icha chi' ol yutok in Mam heb' syak'och spensar t'ayin.
Ha exxo tik, toxo ix b'o he pensar yuj juntzanh in k'ayb'ub'al ix wal t'ayex.
Ochanhek kajan t'ayin, a inxo ol in ochpax kajan t'ayex. Icha junok te' sk'ab' tz'elta jeknaj t'a snunal maxtzak satanlaj, icha chi' ol ex ajok tato manh ex ayokoch t'ayin.

Ha in tik, icha snunal te' uwa waji. Ha exxo tik, icha te' sk'ab' eyaji. Tato junnhej heyaj wet'ok, junnhej pax waj heyet'ok, icha junok te' sk'ab' tzijtum sat syak'a', icha chi' ol ex ajok. Palta malaj jab'ok tas syal eyuj he ch'okoj.
K'inalok ay heb' manh ayokoch t'ayin, lajan ol aj heb' icha junok te' sk'ab' stzepji'el t'a snunal, stakji. Slajwi chi', smolb'aji, snhusjitz'a'ok.
Tato junnhej heyaj wet'ok, tato tzeyak'nhejoch he pensar t'a in lolonel, k'anek tas tze nib'ej ol ak'jok t'ayex.
Tato niwan tas wach' scheklajel t'a he b'eyb'al, ol aljok in Mam wach'il eyu'uj. Ichaton chi' ol eyutok he ch'oxaneli to in k'ayb'um ex.
Icha ix yutej in Mam in xajanani, icha pax chi' tzex wutej ex in xajanani. Yuj chi' tzin he k'anab'ajejnhej, yik wach' ol eyab'i to xajanexnhej wu'uj.

Tato tze k'anab'ajej juntzanh in cheknab'il, ol eyab'i to xajanexnhej wu'uj, yujto icha chi' waj yet' in Mam. Ha in tik tzin k'anab'ajej juntzanh scheknab'il in Mam chi', yuj chi' swab'i to xajan innhej yuj.
Swalkan juntzanh tik t'ayex yik wach' icha tzin tzalaji, icha pax chi' ol ex tzalajok, yuj chi' tz'akan ol aj he tzalajk'olal.
Ha tikne'ik ay jun in cheknab'il ol walkan t'ayex to tze xajanej he b'a junjun ex icha swutej ex in xajanani.
Tato ay junok mach syak'cham sb'a yuj heb' yamigo, syalelk'ochi to tzek' wal t'a yib'anh xajanan heb' yamigo chi'.
Ha ex tik, tato tze k'anab'ajej juntzanh in cheknab'il tik, wal yel wamigo ex toni.

Ha tikne'ik swal t'ayex, manh tonhejok in chekab' eyaji, yujto a junok chekab', manh yojtakok tas sna spatrón. Palta a tikne'ik wamigo ex, yujto a jantaknhej tas yalnakkan in Mam t'ayin, ix walxikan t'ayex.

Manhokexlaj ix in he sayek'i, palta a in ix ex in sik'elta, yik wach' tze k'ulej tas tzin nib'ej. Ha tas tze k'ulej chi', ol kannhej t'a junelnhej. Yuj chi' a jantaknhej tas tze k'an t'a ko Mam Dios t'a in b'i, ol yak'nhej t'ayex.
Haton jun in cheknab'il tik swalkan t'ayex, to slaj he xajanej he b'a junjun ex.
Tato ay heb' yik yol yib'anhk'inal tik tz'och ajk'olal t'ayex, na'ekkoti to a t'ayin sb'ab'lajoch heb' ajk'olal.

K'inalok yik ex yol yib'anhk'inal tik yet' heb', tekan xajanex yuj heb'. Palta manhxo ex yikok yol yib'anhk'inal tik, yujto toxo ex in sik'kanelta t'a skal heb'. Yuj chi' tz'och heb' ajk'olal t'ayex, yujto manhxo eyetb'eyumok he b'a yet' heb'.

Tze na wal kot jun lolonel ix wal tik t'ayex: Malaj junok chekab' ek'al yelk'och t'a yichanh spatrón, xin chi t'ayex. Icha yutejnak heb' yak'anoch in yahelal, icha pax chi' ol yutok heb' yak'anoch eyahelal. Tato ix sk'anab'ajej in k'ayb'ub'al heb', ol sk'anab'ajej pax heyik heb'.
Ol laj yak'och yahelal heb' t'a eyib'anh wu'uj, yujto manh yojtakoklaj heb' mach chekjinak in koti.
K'inalok max ul wal t'a heb', malaj am smul heb'. Palta a tikne'ik, manhxa b'aj wach' skolan sb'a heb' yuj smul.
Ha heb' tz'och ajk'olal t'ayin, tz'ochpax heb' ajk'olal t'a in Mam.

Ha juntzanh satub'tak ix laj in ch'ox t'a skal heb', malaj junokxo mach syal yuj icha chi'. K'inalok malaj juntzanh satub'tak chi' ix in ch'oxo', malaj am smul heb'. Haxo tikne'ik, wach'chom ix yil juntzanh chi' heb', palta hanheja' ayoch heb' ajk'olal t'ayin, ajk'o'ol pax heb' t'a in Mam.

Palta icha tik ix aj yelk'och juntzanh tik, yik tz'elk'och tas tz'ib'yajkan t'a ley b'aj niwanok syak'och spensar heb'. Haton jun tz'alan icha tik: Nab'anhej skomon och heb' ajk'olal t'ayin, xchi t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani.
Palta ay junxo Kolwajum ol kot t'a ko Mam Dios, haton Yespíritu yel syala'. Ol b'at in chekkoti. A' ol yak' testigo'al sb'a wu'uj.
Hanhejtona', ich ex ta', ol eyak' testigo'al he b'a, yujto junnhej ek'nak ex wet'ok yiktax ix el yich in munlajel tik.
Swalkan juntzanh tik t'ayex, yik manh ol ex somchajelok.
Yujto ol laj ex pechji'elta yuj heb' ketisraelal t'a yol spatil culto. Ay jun pekti' ol jawok, yalxonhej mach ol ex milanok, a sna'an heb' to pawor syak' heb' t'a Dios.
Icha chi' ol yutok sb'a heb', yujto manh yojtakok in Mam heb', manh in yojtakok pax heb'.
Swalkan juntzanh tik t'ayex, yik wach' ayik ol ja jun pekti' chi', ol he nakoti to walnakxokan t'ayex. Maj wal-laj juntzanh tik t'ayex t'a yik yalanh, yujto ayinto ek' eyet' ta'.
Haxo tikne'ik, ol in pax t'a jun chekjinak in koti. Palta malaj junok ex tze k'anb'ej t'ayin b'ajtil ol in k'ochok.
Tonhej tzex te och ilk'olal yuj juntzanh swalkan tik t'ayex.
Wal yel swal t'ayex, te wach' eyiko' yujto ol in paxok. Tato manh ol in paxok, manh ol jawoklaj jun t'inhan skolwaj chi' heyet'ok. Palta ayik ol in paxok, ol in chekankot t'ayex.

Haxo ol jawok, ha' ol ak'an yojtakejel heb' yik yol yib'anhk'inal tik to ay smul heb'. Hanheja' ol ak'an yojtakejel heb' to wach'nhej ix wutej in b'a. Ol yak'an yojtakejel heb' to ol ch'olb'itaj tas yaj heb' yuj Dios.
Ol sch'oxan t'a heb' to ay smul heb', yujto max in yak'och heb' t'a sk'o'ol.
A' ol ak'an yojtakejel heb' to wach'nhej ix wutej in b'a, yujto ol in pax b'aj ay ko Mam Dios, b'aj manhxo ol yal-laj in heyilani.
Ol sch'oxan t'a heb' to ol ch'olb'itaj yaj heb' yuj Dios, yujto toxo ix ch'olb'itaj yaj winh yajal yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Tzijtumto tas in gana swal t'ayex, palta maxto techaj eyab'an tikne'ik.

Hato wal ol ja Espíritu yel syala', hato ta' ol ak'jok nachajel eyu'uj masanil tas yel. Manh ol lolonlaj t'a yol yiko', a jantaknhej tas ol aljok t'ay, anhej ol yala'. Ol laj yalan juntzanh tastak toto ol ujok.
Yuj ol cheklajelok to niwan welk'ochi. Jantaknhej tas ol wal t'ay, ha' ol halan pax t'ayex.
Jantaknhej tas ay t'a ko Mam Dios, wiknhej yaji. Yuj chi' ix wala' to a tas ol wal t'a Espíritu chi', ha' ol yal t'ayex.
Junxonhej rato ol in heyila', slajwi chi', manhxo ol in eyil-laj. Ol ek' junokxo rato, ol in eyilanxi, yujto ol in paxk'e b'aj ay in Mam, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.

Ixlajwi yalan jun chi', ay jaywanh heb' sk'ayb'um ix laj halani: --¿Tas syalelk'och jun syal tik t'ayonh? To ix yala': Junxonhej rato ol in heyila', slajwi chi', manhxo ol in eyil-laj. Ol ek' junokxo rato, ol in eyilanxi, xchi. Ix yalanpaxi: Yujto ol in paxk'e b'aj ay in Mam, xchi t'ayonh.
Ha jun “junxonhej rato” syal tik, ¿tastaxlaj syalelk'ochi? Manh jab'ok snachajel ku'uj tas syala', xchi heb'.

Haxo Jesús, yojtakxo to snib'ej heb' sk'anb'ej t'ay tas syalelk'och jun ix yal chi', yuj chi' ix yalanxi t'a heb': --Toxo ix wal t'ayex: Junxonhej rato ol in heyila', slajwi chi', manhxo ol in eyil-laj. Palta ol ek' junokxo rato, ol in eyilanxi, xin chi t'ayex. ¿Tom yuj juntzanh swal tik tze k'anb'an eyab' t'ayex junjun ex?
Wal yel swal t'ayex, ol ex kusok, ol ex ok'ok. Haxo heb' yik yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ol laj k'e chanh heb'. Ha ex tik, ol ex kusok, palta ol meltzajxok och he kusk'olal chi' t'a tzalajk'olal.

K'inalok ay junok ix ix wan yalji yune', skus ix, yujto ayoch ix t'a syahelal, palta ayik toxo ix aj yune' ix chi', maxtzak snakotlaj syahelal ix chi', toxonhej ste tzalaj ix, yujto ix aj jun unin chi' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Icha jun ix chi', icha chi' ol ex ajok. Ol ex kus ton tikne'ik, palta hato yik ol in eyilanxi ol ex tzalajok. Haxo jun he tzalajk'olal chi', malaj junok mach ol yal yik'anek' t'ayex.
Ha t'a jun k'uhal chi' manhxa tas ol he k'anb'ej t'ayin. Wal yel swal t'ayex, masanil tas ol he k'an t'a ko Mam Dios t'a in b'i, ol yak' t'ayex.
Ha tikne'ik, mantalaj tas tze k'an t'a Dios t'a in b'i. k'anek, ol he cha'a, ol ak'jok t'ayex yik ol tz'akwok he tzalajk'olal.
K'exanh ix wutej walan juntzanh lolonel tik t'ayex. Palta ay jun pekti' ol jawok, manhxo ichok ta' ol aj walan t'ayex, yujto tojolxonhej ol wutok walan yab'ixal in Mam t'ayex.
Ayik ol ja jun k'uhal chi', hato ta' ol he k'an tas tze nib'ej t'a in b'i. Max wal-laj t'ayex tato a in ol in k'an tas t'a in Mam eyu'uj.
Xajan ex yuj in Mam chi', yujto xajan in eyu'uj, ix eyak'och t'a he k'o'ol to a t'ay kotnak in.
Yel toni a t'ay kotnak in, in jawi t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Ha tikne'ik, ol waktejkani, haxo in paxk'e t'a in Mam chi', xchi t'a heb'.
Haxo heb' sk'ayb'um chi' ix halan t'ay: --Ha tikne'ik te tojolxo tzutej halan t'ayonh. Manhxo k'exanhok tzutej halan icha t'a junel.
Ha tikne'ik, snachajel ku'uj to ojtaknhej masanil tasi. Manh yowalilok tzato ko k'anb'ej t'ayach ayik tzalan t'ayonh. Yuj chi' skak'och t'a ko k'o'ol to a t'a Dios kotnak ach, xchi heb' t'ay.
Yuj chi' ix yalxi t'a heb': --¿Tzam in eyak'och t'a he k'o'ol tikne'ik?
Palta wanxo sja stiempo'al ol ex saklemkanb'atok. Ol laj ex b'at elelal junjun ex. Ol in eyaktejkan in ch'okoj, palta manh in ch'okojok ol in kanok, ayek' in Mam wet'ok.

Ix wal masanil juntzanh tik t'ayex, yik wach' junk'olalxo ol ex aj wu'uj. Ha t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ol eyab' ton sya'il. Palta tek'an tzeyutej he b'a, yujto a heb' yik yol yib'anhk'inal tik, toxo ix kan heb' t'a yalanh wu'uj, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi yalan juntzanh chi' Jesús, ix k'e k'elan t'a satcha'anh, ix yalani: --Mamin, toxo ix ja stiempo'al a ch'oxaneli to niwan welk'och a in Uninal in tik, yik ol in ch'oxpaxel sniwanil elk'ochi.
Yujto a ach ak'nak wopisio t'a yib'anh masanil heb' anima yik wach' swak' sk'inal jantaknhej heb' ix ak' t'ayin.
Ha jun k 'inal t'a junelnhej tik, syalelk'ochi to tzach yojtakejel heb' anima to a achnhejton Dios ach t'a wal yel yet' pax in yojtakanel heb' a in Jesucristo chekb'il in kot u'uj tik.
Ayik ayinek' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ix in ch'oxo' to te niwan elk'ochi. Ha jun munlajel ak'b'ilkan tik t'ayin u'uj, toxo ix yik' sb'a.
Ayik manto b'o jun yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ayinek' et' b'aj ay ko wach'il. Haxo tikne'ik Mamin, cha in paxk'e et' b'aj ay ko wach'il chi' ichataxon waj het'ok.
Ha heb' ix a sik'elta t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ix ak' heb' t'ayin, ix in ch'ox t'a heb' tas nab'il u'uj. Ha heb' ix ak' t'ayin, toxonton ik heb'. Ix laj sk'anab'ajej a lolonel heb'.
Ha tikne'ik, a jantaknhej tas ak'nak t'ayin, yojtak heb' to a t'ayach kotnak.
Ha a lolonel ak'nak t'ayin, ix laj wal t'a heb'. Ix scha'an yab' heb', yuj chi' yojtak heb' to yel t'ayach kotnak in. Syak'och heb' t'a sk'o'ol to a ach a cheknak in koti.
Tzin lesalwi yuj heb' ix ak' t'ayin, yujto ikxo heb'. Haxo heb' yik yol yib'anhk'inal tik, max in lesalwilaj yuj heb'.
Jantaknhej heb' wiko', ikxo pax yaj heb'. Hanhejtona' heb' iko', wikxo pax heb' het'ok. Haton heb' tik sch'oxaneli to te niwan welk'ochi.

Jab'xonhej tiempo ayinek' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, haxo in paxk'e chi' het'ok. Haxo pax heb' tik jun, ol to kan heb' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Mamin, te tojol achnhej. Ha heb' ix ak' t'ayin, tza tanhwej heb' yet' a poder, haton jun ix ak' t'ayin, yik junxonhej tz'aj heb' icha waj het'ok.

Ayik ayinek' yet' heb' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ix in tanhwej heb' yet' a poder chi'. Ha heb' ix ak' t'ayin, ix in tanhwej heb' yik malaj tz'ik'an heb', malaj junok heb' ix sateli, anhej jun t'inhantaxon sateli yik tz'elk'och tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a a lolonel.
Ha tikne'ik jun, ol in paxixk'e t'ayach. Yakb'an ayinto ek' jab'okxo t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, swalankan juntzanh tik yik wach' ol tzalaj heb' icha in tzalaj tik.

Toxo ix laj walkanel a lolonel t'a heb'. Palta a heb' yik yol yib'anhk'inal tik tz'och heb' ajk'olal t'a heb', yujto manhxo yikok yol yib'anhk'inal heb' yet' heb'. Icha in tik, manh in yikok yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Mantok swala' to elanhchamel tzik'el heb' t'a tik. Palta tzin k'an t'ayach to tza tanhwej heb', yik malaj heb' tz'ixtaxel yuj winh chuk chi'.
Ha in tik, manh in yikok yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Hanhejtona' icha chi' heb', manh yikok yol yib'anhk'inal tik heb'.
Ha ach tza tojolb'itej spensar heb' yet' a lolonel te yel.
Icha ix utej in a chekankot t'a skal heb' anima tik, icha chi' swutej in chekanpaxb'at heb' t'a skal heb' anima chi'.
Yuj swach'ilok heb' yuj chi' swak' in b'a t'ayach, yik wach' tz'och heb' ikok t'a wal yel.
Manh yujoknhej heb' tzin lesalwi. Tzin lesalwi pax yuj heb' toto ol in ak'anoch t'a sk'o'ol yuj tastak ol yal heb' in chekab' tik.

Tzin k'an t'ayach yik junxonhej ol aj spensar heb' smasanil. Mamin, junnhej waj het'ok, junnhej pax aj wet'ok. Ichok wal kaji, ichokab' ta tz'aj pax heb', junnhejokab' tz'aj heb' ket'ok. Tato icha chi', haxo heb' anima t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ol yak'och heb' t'a sk'o'ol to a ach a cheknak in koti.
Ha sniwanil welk'och ix ak'a', a ix wak'pax t'a heb', yik junxonhej tz'aj spensar heb' icha waj het'ok.

Ha in ayin och t'a heb', a hachxo ayach och t'ayin, yik wach' junxonhej ol aj spensar heb'. Yuj chi' ol nachajel yuj heb' yik yol yib'anhk'inal tik to a ach a cheknak in koti. Ol nachajel yuj heb' to icha tzutej in a xajanani, icha pax chi' tzutej a xajanan heb' kikxo.
Mamin, a heb' tzak' t'ayin, in gana ol aj heb' wet' b'aj ol in k'ochok, yik ol yil in wach'il heb' ak'b'il t'ayin u'uj, yujto xajanintaxon u'uj atax yik mantzak b'o jun yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Mamin, tojol a pensar, a heb' yik yol yib'anhk'inal tik, manh ach yojtakok heb'. Xal in tik, wojtak ach. Haxo heb' tik, yojtakxo heb' to a ach a cheknak in koti.

Ha in ix wak' yojtakejel heb' tas aji. Hanhejtona' ol in wach' ak'ej yojtakejxi'el heb', yik wach' icha tzutej in a xajanani, icha pax chi' tzutej a xajanan heb'. Ha inxo ol in och kajan t'a heb' t'a junelnhej, xchi Jesús t'a ko Mam Dios.
Ixlajwi yalan juntzanh chi' Jesús, ix b'at yet' heb' sk'ayb'um. Ix k'axpajek' heb' t'a sch'olanil ha' Cedrón b'aj ay juntzanh te' awb'en te'. Ix k'och heb' t'a skal te'.
Haxo winhaj Judas, winh ol ak'anoch Jesús t'a yol sk'ab' chamel, yojtak pax jun lugar chi' winh, yujto tzijtum el ix smolb'ej sb'a Jesús chi' yet' heb' sk'ayb'um ta'.

Yuj chi' ix k'och winh ta', ajun jun umanh heb' soldado yet' winh yet' pax heb' stanhwumal stemplo Dios ix chekjikot yuj heb' winh sat sacerdote yet' heb' winh fariseo. Tz'ikb'il sk'ak' heb', ma scandil heb' yuj. Yet'nak pax syamk'ab' heb' yik owal ix k'och heb'.
Haxo Jesús yojtakxo jantak tas ol jawok t'a yib'anh. Yuj chi' ix sch'oxan sb'a, ix sk'anb'an t'a heb' winh ix k'och chi': --¿Mach tzek' he saya'? xchi t'a heb' winh.
--Ha Jesús aj Nazaret, a sko sayek'i, xchi heb' winh t'ay. --Ha in ton tik, xchi t'a heb' winh. Ha winhaj Judas, winh wan yak'anoch Jesús t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'o'ol chi', ajun winh yet' heb' winh.
Ix lajwinhej yalan Jesús t'a heb' winh, ix b'at pak'aljok heb' winh t'a spatik, ix laj telwi heb' winh t'a sat lu'um.
Ix sk'anb'anxi Jesús t'a heb' winh: --¿Mach tzek' he saya'? xchi. --Ha Jesús aj Nazaret, a tzek' ko saya', xchixi heb' winh.
--Palta toxo ix wal t'ayex to a in ton tik. Tato a in tzin he saya', haxo heb' winh wet'nak tik, aktejek el heb' winh, xchi t'a heb' winh.
Icha chi' ix aj yelk'och tas ix yal Jesús yuj heb' sk'ayb'um, ayik ix yalan icha tik: Ha heb' ix ak' t'ayin malaj junok heb' ix sat wu'uj, xchi t'a Dios.
Haxo winhaj Simón Pedro, ix yik'ank'eta k'e'en yespada winh t'a yol yatut, ix b'at juknaj winh t'a jun winh skuch Malco, schekab' winh sat sacerdote. Ix slesanel schikin winh winh t'a swach'.
Haxo ix yalan Jesús t'a winhaj Pedro chi': --Hak'em k'e'en espada chi' t'a yol yatut. ¿Tom manh ol wak' in b'a t'a jun yahelal syak'kot in Mam t'a wib'anh tik a na'ani? xchi t'a winh.
Ix syaman Jesús chi' heb' winh soldado yet' winh syajalil heb' yet' heb' winh aj Judea stanhwumal templo.
Ichato chi' ix ik'jib'at t'a spat winhaj Anás, snhi' winhaj Caifás. Ha winhaj Caifás chi' sat sacerdote yaj t'a jun ab'il chi'.
Haton winh alannak t'a heb' aj Judea chi' to yowalil scham junok mach sk'exulok heb' anima smasanil.

Ayik ix ik'jib'at Jesús, tzak'anoch winhaj Simón Pedro yuj yet' junxo winh sk'ayb'um Jesús chi'. Ha junxo winh sk'ayb'um chi', ojtakab'il winh yuj winhaj Anás chi'. Ix ochk'och winh yet' Jesús t'a yamak'il spat winhaj Anás chi'.
Haxo winhaj Pedro chi', ix kan winh t'a ti' pat chi'. Yuj chi' ix elixta junxo winh sk'ayb'um Jesús chi', ix yalan winh t'a ix stanhwumal ti' pat chi' to tz'och winhaj Pedro chi' yet' heb'.
Haxo ix stanhwumal ti' pat chi' ix halan t'a winhaj Pedro chi': --Ha ach tik, tekan sk'ayb'um ach jun winh ix yamchaj tik, xchi ix t'a winh. --Ma'ay, manh in sk'ayb'umoklaj winh, xchi winh t'a ix.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi' te ay si'ik, yuj chi' haxo heb' winh ayoch chekab'ok yet' heb' winh stanhwumal templo, ix yak'och sk'ak' heb' winh t'a te' ak'al. Linhjab'och heb' winh k'axnel. Haxo winhaj Pedro chi', ix k'och winh yet' heb' winh t'a sti' te' k'ak' chi', ix k'axni winh yet' heb' winh.
Haxo winh sat sacerdote ix k'anb'an t'a Jesús: --¿Mach heb' a k'ayb'um? ¿Tas juntzanh a k'ayb'ub'al b'aj tza k'ayb'ej heb'? xchi winh t'ay.

Ix yalan Jesús chi' t'a winh: --Ha juntzanh in k'ayb'ub'al chi', ix walel t'a skal heb' anima smasanil. Masanil tiempo ix walel t'a yoltak spatil culto yet' t'a yamak'il stemplo Dios yet' b'aj smolb'ej sb'a heb' anima. Malaj junok tas k'ub'eltak ix wala'.
¿Tas yuj a t'ayin tza k'anb'ej? k'anb'ej t'a heb' ix ab'an walani. Yalokab' heb' t'ayach tas juntzanh in k'ayb'ub'al chi'. Ina yojtakxo heb' tas ix wala', xchi t'a winh.
Ix lajwinhej yalan juntzanh chi', haxo jun winh stanhwumal templo ayek' ta' ix tz'itanb'at sat. Ix yalan winh t'ay: --Tas yuj icha chi' tz'aj a pakan sti' winh sat sacerdote tik, xchi winh t'a Jesús.
--Tato chuk ix wala', al t'ayin tas chukal ix wal chi'. Palta tato a tas wach' ix wala', ¿tas yuj tzin a komon mak'ej? xchi Jesús chi' t'a winh.
Ixlajwi chi', haxo winhaj Anás chi' ix chekan ik'jokb'at Jesús t'a winhaj Caifás, winh sat sacerdote. Hanheja' tzek'b'il yuj heb' winh ix b'ati.

Haxo winhaj Pedro hanheja' wan sk'axni winh yet' heb' winh stanhwumal templo chi'. Yuj chi' ix yalan heb' winh t'a winh: --Ha ach tik, tekan sk'ayb'um ach Jesús, xchi heb' winh. Ix yik'anxi'el winh t'a yib'anh, ix yalan winh: --Ma'ay, manh in sk'ayb'umoklaj, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ay jun schekab' winh sat sacerdote, sk'ab' yok sb'a yet' winh ix el schikin yuj winhaj Pedro chi' ix halan t'a winh: --¿Tom manhok ach ix wil ek' yet' Jesús b'aj ay te' awb'en te' jun? xchi t'a winh.
Ix yik'anxi'el winhaj Pedro chi' t'a yib'anh junelxo. Ha wal slajwi yik'anxi'el winh chi' t'a yib'anh, ix ok' nok' kaxlanh.

Haxo yik wan sakb'i, ix ik'ji'el Jesús t'a yol spat winhaj Caifás chi' yuj heb' yajal t'a skal heb' israel, ix ik'jib'at t'a sdespacho winhaj Pilato, winh yajal. Ha sley heb' aj Judea chi', max yal yoch heb' t'a yol sdespacho winh chi'. Ha sna'an heb', talaj tz'och smul heb' t'a yichanh Dios, talaj manh smojok swa'an jun wa'el heb' yik k'inh wan sjawi, yik sna'ankot heb' tas aj yelnakkot heb' smam yicham heb' t'a Egipto.
Yuj chi' ix elta winhaj Pilato chi' t'a sti' sdespacho. Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb': --¿Tas smul jun winh tzul eyak' tik t'ayin? xchi winh.
--Tato manh chukok winh, ¿tom ol ul kak' winh t'a yol a k'ab'? xchi heb' winh.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj Pilato chi': --Ik'ekb'at winh a ex tik, tzeyak'anoch t'a yib'anh winh icha syal he ley, xchi winh. --Palta a onh israel onh tik, max yal-laj ko komon ak'anoch chamel t'a yib'anh junok anima, xchi heb' winh.
Icha chi' ix aj yelk'och tas ix yal Jesús chajtil ol aj schami.
Haxo winhaj Pilato chi', ix ochxikan winh t'a yol sdespacho. Ix yak'an awtajkot Jesús winh, ix sk'anb'an winh t'ay: --¿Tom a ach tik sreyal ach heb' israel? xchi winh.
--¿Tom a ach tza na'el jun chi', mato ch'ok mach ix halan t'ayach wu'uj? xchi Jesús chi' t'a winh.
--¿Tom israel in tzila'? Ha heb' etchonhab' yet' heb' sat sacerdote, a heb' ix ul ach ak'anoch t'a yol in k'ab'. Palta ¿tas ix a mulej? xchi winh t'ay.

--Ha in tik, manhok t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik rey in. K'inalok tato icha chi', a heb' tzin ak'an serwil, tzam yak' yowalil heb', yik max in ak'ji'och t'a yol sk'ab' heb' aj Judea. Palta manhok t'a tik rey in, xchi Jesús chi' t'a winh.

--¿Tom yel wal jun to rey ach? xchi winhaj Pilato chi' t'ay. --Yel toni, rey in, ichaton tzal chi'. Ha in tik, in jawi t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik yik tzul walel jun tas te yel. Yuj wal chi' in alji. Jantaknhej heb' yiktaxon jun yel tik, syak'och schikin heb' t'a tas swala', xchi Jesús chi'.

Haxo ix yalan winhaj Pilato chi' t'ay: --¿Tas jun yel tzal chi'? xchi winh t'ay. Ixlajwi yalan jun chi' winhaj Pilato chi', ix elixta winh t'a sti' b'aj aykan heb' aj Judea chi'. Ix yalanelta winh t'a skal heb': --Ha jun winh tik, malaj jab'ok smul winh swila'.
Palta ay jun he ley t'a junjun k'inh tik to tze k'anelta junok mach t'a preso. Yuj chi', ¿mama he gana swak'el jun winh he reyal a ex israel ex tik t'a libre tikne'ik? xchi winh t'a heb'.

Yuj chi' ix awaj cha'anh heb' smasanil, ix yalan heb': --Ha jun winh tik, malaj ko gana t'a winh. Ha winhaj Barrabás tzak'el t'a libre, xchi heb' t'a winh. Palta a winhaj Barrabás chi', milumcham anima winh.
Haxo winhaj Pilato ix chekan ik'jokb'at Jesús yik' b'at mak'jok.
Ixlajwi chi', ix sjalan setan jun k'i'ix heb' winh soldado, ix yak'ank'e heb' winh scorona'ok Jesús chi'. Ix yak'anoch jun k'apak heb' winh t'ay, k'ik' mutz'inak icha yik heb' rey.
Ix laj k'och heb' winh t'a stz'ey, ix stz'akan yal heb' winh t'ay: --Tzalajanh ach sreyal heb' israel, xchi heb' winh t'ay. Ix tz'itjib'at sat yuj heb' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix elta winhaj Pilato t'a sti' b'aj aykan heb' aj Judea chi'. Ix yalanelta winh t'a skal heb': --Ileknab'i, tik tzin ch'oxelta winh t'ayex, yik wach' tzeyojtakejeli to malaj jab'ok smul winh ix ilchaj wu'uj, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Ichato chi' ix elta Jesús t'a sti'. Hanheja' ayk'e jun k'i'ix chi' t'a sjolom, hanheja' aypaxoch jun k'ik' mutz'inak k'apak chi' yuj. Ix yalanxi'elta winhaj Pilato chi' t'a heb': --Ina winh tik, xchi winh.

Ayik ix yilan heb' winh sat sacerdote yet' heb' winh stanhwumal templo yelk'och Jesús t'a sti' chi', ix k'e umnaj heb' winh yalani: --Kulusejk'e winh. Kulusejk'e winh, xchi heb' winh. Ix yalanpax winhaj Pilato chi' t'a heb': --Ik'ekb'at winh a ex tik, tze kulusank'e winh he ch'okoj. Xal in tik, malaj jab'ok smul winh tz'ilchaj wu'uj, xchi winh.
Ix yalanpax heb' aj Judea chi' t'a winh: --Palta ay jun ley aykan t'ayonh. Yuj jun ley chi' yowalil ol miljokcham jun winh tik, yujto ix yaloch sb'a winh Yuninalok Dios, xchi heb'.
Haxo ix yab'an jun chi' winhaj Pilato chi', ix te xiwb'at winh.
Yuj chi' ix ochxik'och winh t'a yol sdespacho, ix sk'anb'an winh t'a Jesús: --¿B'ajtil kotnak ach jun? xchi winh t'ay. Palta maj tak'woklaj Jesús chi' t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalanxi winh t'ay: --¿Tas yuj max ach tak'wi t'ayin? ¿Tom manh ojtakok to ay wopisio ach wak'anel t'a libre, ay pax wopisio ach in kulusank'e'i? xchi winh t'ay.

Ix yalan Jesús t'a winh: --Palta haton Dios ak'jinak opisio chi'. Tato ma'ay, malaj halan jab'ok ik t'ayin. Yuj chi' a winh ix in ak'anoch t'a yol a k'ab', te ek'alto smul winh t'a ichanh, xchi t'a winh.

Ixlajwi yab'an juntzanh chi' winh, ix sna'an winh tas syutej yak'anel Jesús chi' t'a libre. Haxo heb' aj Judea chi', ix k'e umnaj heb' yalani: --Tato tzak'el winh t'a libre, ajk'o'ol ach t'a winh yajal t'a Roma syal chi'. Ha winh tik ix yaloch sb'a winh reyal. Palta a mach tz'alan icha chi', ajk'o'ol t'a winh yajal t'a Roma chi', xchi heb' t'a winh.

Ixlajwi yab'an jun chi' winh, ix yalan winh to tz'ik'jikot Jesús chi' b'aj ayek' winh chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix em k'ojan winh t'a sk'ojnub' b'aj sb'o yaj owal. Ha jun lugar chi', Gabata sb'i t'a hebreo. Syalelk'ochi, b'aj latz'b'ilem k'e'en k'e'en.

Ayik ix em k'ojan winh chi', wanxo yoch chimk'uhalil. K'ik'anokxo sk'inh heb' israel yik sna'ankot heb' tas aj yelnakkot heb' smam yicham heb' t'a Egipto. Haxo ix yalanpaxelta winh t'a skal heb' aj Judea chi': --Ina winh he reyal tik, xchielta winh t'a heb'.

Palta ix laj awaj cha'anh heb' junelxo: --Chamokab' winh. Chamokab' winh. Kulusejk'e winh, xchi heb'. --¿Tom swak' kulusejk'e winh he reyal tik? xchi winh t'a heb'. Haxo heb' winh sat sacerdote ix tak'wi: --Ha onh tik, anhej winh yajal t'a Roma ko reyal. Malaj junokxo, xchi heb' winh.
Ichato chi' ix ak'ji'och Jesús t'a yol sk'ab' heb' yik skulusajk'e'i. Yuj chi' ix yik'b'at Jesús chi' heb'.
Haxo Jesús ix kuchan skulusal, ix ik'jib'at t'a jun lugar skuchan Gólgota t'a hebreo. Syalelk'ochi: B'aj Ay Sb'akil Jolom.
Hata' ix kulusajk'e Jesús yuj heb'. Ay chawanhxo heb' winh ix kulusajk'e yet'ok, jun winh t'a swach', junxo winh t'a sk'exanh, haxo t'a snanhal skulusal heb' winh chi' ix kulusajk'e Jesús chi'.

Haxo winhaj Pilato chi' ix ak'an tz'ib'chajoch juntzanh lolonel t'a jun yune' chem te'. Ix yak'an ak'jokoch winh t'a sjolom skulusal Jesús chi'. Icha tik syal jun chi': Ha Jesús aj Nazaret, Sreyal heb' israel, xchi.

Ha jun lugar b'aj ix kulusajk'e Jesús chi', ha t'a ti' chonhab' ay. Yuj chi' tzijtum heb' israel ix ilan juntzanh lolonel chi'. Ha t'a hebreo, t'a griego yet' pax t'a latín, haton sti' heb' aj Roma, hata' ix tz'ib'chajochi.

Yuj chi' ix yal heb' winh sat sacerdote t'a winhaj Pilato chi': --Oktom manhok Sreyal heb' israel ix ak' tz'ib'chajochok. Oktom tzak' tz'ib'chaj icha tik: Ha winh tik, ix yaloch sb'a winh Sreyalok heb' israel, xchi heb' winh t'a winh.
--Ha tas ix wak' tz'ib'chajok, skannhej icha chi', xchi winhaj Pilato chi' t'a heb' winh.

Haxo heb' winh soldado, ayik manto skulusejk'e Jesús heb' winh, ix kichji'el spichul yuj heb' winh. Ix spukanek' heb' winh t'a spatik. Chanh poj ix aji. Junjun yik junjun heb' winh. Palta haxo jun kolxo spichul, jalb'ilkot t'a sjolom masanto t'a yoktak, malaj stz'isul.

Yuj chi' ix yal heb' winh icha tik: --Tekan a jun tik manh ol ko nhik'chitejb'ati. Wach' hama to skak'ek ko suerte t'a yib'anh, yalnhej mach onh ol kik'a', xchi heb' winh. Icha chi' ix aj yelk'och tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a Slolonel Dios, ayik yalannakkani: Ol spukek' in pichul heb' t'a spatik, ol yak'an suerte heb' t'a yib'anh junxo, xchi. Yuj chi' icha chi' ix yutej heb' winh soldado chi'.
Linhanoch ix snun Jesús t'a stz'ey te' kulus chi', ajun ix snulej ix yet'ok yet' ix María ix yetb'eyum winhaj Cleofas yet' ix María aj Magdala.

Ay pax ek' jun winh sk'ayb'um Jesús t'a stz'ey ix snun chi', haton jun winh te xajan yuj. Ayik ix iljikot heb' yuj Jesús, ix yalan t'a ix snun chi': --Nunin, a jun ayek' et' tik, icha une' tzutej, xchi t'a ix.

Ix lajwinhej chi', ix yalan t'a jun winh sk'ayb'um chi': --Ha ix in nun tik, icha a nun tzutej ix, xchi. Yuj chi', a jun winh sk'ayb'um chi' ix ik'ankanoch ix snun Jesús chi' t'a yol spat. Atax ta' kannak ix yet'ok.

Ixlajwi chi', yojtakxo Jesús to ix elk'och masanil tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a yib'anh. Yuj chi' ix yal icha tik: --Stakji wal in ti', xchi. Icha chi' ix yutej yalani yik tz'elk'och tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a Slolonel Dios.
Ayek' jun chen vinagre ta'. Ix yak'anoch jun tz'ub'lab' heb' t'a sjolom jun te' hisopo, ix slab'anem heb' t'a skal jun vinagre chi', ix yak'anoch heb' t'a sti' Jesús chi'.
Ix stz'ub'an jun vinagre chi', ix lajwi chi' ix yalani: --Toxo ix yik' sb'a smasanil, xchi. Ixlajwi chi', ix em nhojnaj schami.

Ha t'a jun k'u chi', k'ik'anokxo tz'och sk'inh heb' israel yik sna'ankot heb' tas aj yelnakkot heb' smam yicham heb' t'a Egipto, sk'uhal ik'oj ip yaj t'a heb'. Ha heb' winh aj Judea malaj snib'ej heb' winh skan sniwanil heb' kulusab'il t'a te' kulus chi', yujto a jun k'inh sja chi', te niwan k'inh syutej heb'. Yuj chi' ix b'at heb' sk'an t'a winhaj Pilato to syak' mak'jok poj sb'akil sat spenek heb' winh, yik tz'ik'ji'emta heb' t'a te' kulus chi'.
Yuj chi' ix k'och heb' winh soldado b'aj ix kulusajk'e heb' chi'. Ha heb' winh kulusalb'ilk'e yet' Jesús chi', ix mak'jipoj sb'akil sat spenek heb' winh.
Palta haxo yik ix k'och heb' winh t'a stz'ey Jesús chi', ix yilan heb' winh to chamnakxo, majxo smak'pojlaj sb'akil sat spenek chi' heb' winh.
Palta ay jun winh soldado ix tipanoch k'e'en slanza t'a skostil Jesús chi'. Yuj chi' ix elta usnaj chik' yet' ha ha'.
Ha in tik, ix wil wal juntzanh tik. Yuj chi' swak' testigo'al in b'a yuj, yik ol eyak'och t'a he k'o'ol. Ha juntzanh tzin tz'ib'ejkan tik, te yel. Ha in tik wojtak to te yel swala'.
Ix uji juntzanh tik, yik tz'elk'och tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a Slolonel Dios ayik syalan icha tik: Malaj junok sb'akil ol smak' poj heb', xchi.
Syalanpax junxo tik t'a Slolonel chi': Ol yil jun mach b'aj stipnakoch k'e'en lanza heb', xchi.

Ay jun winh skuchan José aj chonhab' Arimatea. Sk'ayb'um winh Jesús t'a k'ub'eltak, yujto xiw winh t'a heb' winh aj Judea. Xit' sk'anan spermiso winh t'a winhaj Pilato yik syik'emta sniwanil Jesús chi' winh t'a te' kulus, b'at smukan winh. Haxo winhaj Pilato chi' ix ak'an spermiso winh yik'anemta. Yuj chi' ix yik'anb'at winh.

Ajun pax winhaj Nicodemo winh xit'nakek' sk'umej Jesús t'ak'walil yet'nak winh. Ay am oxe'ok arroba juntzanh suk'uk'i sjab' skuchan mirra kalan yaj yet' junxo skuchan áloes yet'nak winhaj Nicodemo chi'.

Ix yik'anb'at sniwanil Jesús chi' heb' winh. Ix spichan heb' winh t'a jun k'apak. Ix yak'anoch jun suk'uk'i sjab' chi' heb' winh t'ay, yujto icha chi' sley heb' israel chi' ayik smukan heb' chamnak heb'.
Haxo t'a slak'anil b'aj ix kulusajk'e Jesús chi' ay jun awb'en te'. Hata' ay jun k'e'en k'e'en joyb'ilel yo'ol. Ha jun k'e'en chi', manta junok chamnak tz'ak'ji'och t'a yol k'e'en.
Haxo jun sk'uhal ik'oj ip, toxo syamchajochi. Yuj chi' ha t'a yol jun k'e'en chi' ix ak'ji'och sniwanil Jesús chi', yujto lak'an ay k'e'en b'aj ix cham chi'.
Ha t'a domingoal, ayto sakb'i, ix b'at ix María Magdalena b'aj ix mukchajkanoch sniwanil Jesús chi'. Ix yilan ix to toxo ix ik'ji'el smakul b'aj mukan chi'.

Yuj chi' elanhchamel ix b'at lemnaj ix, haxo ix k'och ix t'a winhaj Simón Pedro yet' t'a junxo winh sk'ayb'um Jesús, haton winh te xajan yuj Jesús chi'. Ix yalan ix t'a heb' winh: --Toxo ix ik'jib'at sniwanil Kajal Jesús b'aj mukan, ¿b'aj am ix yak' heb'? xchi ix t'a heb' winh.
Ixlajwi yab'an jun chi' winhaj Pedro yet' junxo winh sk'ayb'um Jesús chi', ix b'at heb' winh, ix b'at yilan heb' winh b'aj ay k'e'en k'e'en chi'.
Elanhchamel ix b'at heb' winh schawanhil. Palta ix tzak'lajkan winhaj Pedro chi'. Yuj chi' a junxo winh k'ayb'um chi' ix b'ab'lajk'ochi.
Ix och t'anhan winh t'a sti' k'e'en. Ix yilanoch jun k'apak winh lanhanek'i. Palta maj ochlaj winh t'a yol k'e'en.
Haxo winhaj Simón Pedro chi' tzak'anto ix k'och winh. B'enhej ix ochb'at winh t'a yol k'e'en. Ix yilan winh, lanhanek' juntzanh k'apak chi'.
Ha junxo k'apak sb'ak'ul sjolom Jesús chi', pakb'ilkan k'apak, ch'ok aykankot k'apak.
Ichato chi' ix ochk'och junxo winh k'ayb'um ix b'ab'laj k'och chi'. Ayik ix yilan jun chi' winh, ix yak'och winh t'a sk'o'ol to ix pitzwixi Jesús.
Maxto nachajel yuj heb' winh tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a Slolonel Dios to yowalil ol pitzwokxi Jesús t'a skal heb' chamnak.
Ixlajwi chi', ix paxkan heb' winh t'a spat junjun.
Haxo ix María aj Magdala, ix kan ix t'a stz'ey jun k'e'en chi'. Maj ochlaj ix t'a yol k'e'en. Wan yok' ix, ix och t'anhan ix t'a sti' k'e'en.
Haxo ix yilan ix, ayelta chawanh ángel t'a yol k'e'en. Te sak spichul heb'. k'ojjab'em heb' b'aj ix em sniwanil Jesús chi', jun t'a sjolomtak, jun t'a yoktak.
Ix sk'anb'anelta heb' t'a ix: --Ach ix, ¿tas yuj tzach ok'i? xchielta heb'. --Tzin ok'i yujto ix ik'jib'at sniwanil winh Wajal t'a tik. ¿B'aj am ix yak' heb'? xchi ix t'a heb'.
Wanto yalan jun chi' ix, ix b'at k'elan ix t'a spatik. Haxo ix yilan ix ayek' Jesús chi', palta maj yilochlaj ix tato ha'.

Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'an t'a ix: --Ach ix, ¿tas yuj tzach ok'i? ¿Mach tza sayek'i? xchi t'a ix. Palta a sna'an ix to a winh yilumal te' awb'en te' chi' linhanek' ta'. Yuj chi' ix yalan ix: --Ach wetanima'il, tato a ach ix ul ik'el sniwanil Jesús chi', al wal t'ayin b'ajtil ix b'at ak'kani yik ol wik'b'ati, xchi ix t'ay.
--María, xchi Jesús chi' t'a ix. Yuj chi' ix meltzajb'at k'elan ix t'ay. Ix yalan ix t'a sti' hebreo: --Raboni, xchi ix. Syalelk'ochi, Ach in k'ayb'umal.

Ix yalan t'a ix: --Manh in a yama', yujto manto in paxk'e b'aj ay in Mam. Ixik al t'a heb' wuk'tak yet' t'a heb' wanab' smasanil to ol in paxk'e b'aj ay in Mam. Ha in Mam chi', he Mam pax wet'ok. Ha in Diosal, he Diosal pax wet'ok, xchi Jesús chi' t'a ix.
Yuj chi' ix b'at ix yal t'a heb' sk'ayb'um Jesús chi': --Ix wil Kajal Jesús, xchi ix t'a heb'. Ix laj yalan ix t'a heb' tastak ix yal t'a ix.

Hanheja' t'a jun domingo chi' t'a k'ik'b'alil, ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' sk'ayb'um Jesús chi'. nhab'ab'i ix aj spuerta'il jun pat chi', yujto xiw heb' t'a heb' winh aj Judea. Haxo ix yilan heb' ayxo'ek' Jesús t'a skal heb', ix yalan t'a heb': --Junk'olalokab' eyaji, xchi t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix sch'oxan yol sk'ab' yet' skostil t'a heb'. Haxo heb' sk'ayb'um chi', ix te tzalaj heb' yilan Kajal Jesús chi'.
Ix yalanpax junelxo: --Junk'olalokab' eyaji. Icha ix yutej ko Mam Dios in schekankoti, icha chi' swutej ex in chekanb'ati, xchi t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi yalan juntzanh chi', ix spu'anek' yik' t'a yib'anh heb', ix yalani: --Cha'ek Yespíritu Dios.
Tato ay heb' tzeyak' niwank'olal smul, hanhejtona' ol ak'jokpax lajwok smul heb' yuj Dios. Tato ay heb' max eyak' niwank'olal smul chi', ol kannhej smul heb' chi' t'a yib'anh, xchi t'a heb'.
Palta ay jun winh yetb'eyum heb' sk'ayb'um Jesús chi' skuchan Tomás, tz'alji Tioxal. Manh ayokek'laj winh yet' heb' ayik ix ek' Jesús chi' ta'.

Yuj chi' ix yal heb' yetk'ayb'umal winh chi' t'ay: --Ix kil Kajal Jesús, xchi heb' winh. --Ok in wal swil b'aj ix ek' k'e'en lawux t'a yol sk'ab', swekanoch yiximal in k'ab' t'a yolanil b'aj ix ek' k'e'en chi', swak'anpaxoch in k'ab' t'a skostil, ichato chi', ol wak'anoch t'a in k'o'ol tato a wal Jesús chi', xchi winhaj Tomás chi'.

Ukub'ixitax chi', ix smolb'anxi sb'a heb' t'a yol jun pat chi'. Ayxo pax ek' winhaj Tomás chi' yet' heb'. nhab'ab'i yaj jun pat chi' sch'apan heb', palta ix yilan heb', ayxo'ek' Jesús chi' t'a skal heb'. Ix yalan t'a heb': --Junk'olalokab' eyaji, xchi.

Ix lajwinhej chi', ix yalan t'a winhaj Tomás chi': --Ilnab' in k'ab' tik. Ekoch yiximal a k'ab' t'a yolanil tik. Tzak'anpaxoch a k'ab' t'a yolanil in kostil tik. Manh ak' chab'k'olal. Ak' in wal och t'a a k'o'ol, xchi t'a winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Tomás chi' t'ay: --Ach Wajalil, ach in Diosal, xchi winh.
Ix yalanxi Jesús chi' t'a winh: --In ak'och t'a a k'o'ol yujto in ila'. Ha heb' max in hilani, tato tzin yak'och heb' t'a sk'o'ol, te' wach' yik heb', xchi t'a winh.
Tzijtumto juntzanhxo tas satub'tak ix sch'ox Jesús t'a yichanh heb' sk'ayb'um, palta manh tz'ib'ab'iloklajkan t'a jun u'um tik.
Palta a juntzanh tik tz'ib'ab'ilkani yik tzeyak'och t'a he k'o'ol to a Jesús haton Cristo, Yuninal Dios. Tato icha chi' ol eyutok eyak'anoch t'a he k'o'ol, ol he cha he k 'inal t'a junelnhej yuj.
Haxo junelxo, ix sch'oxxi sb'a Jesús t'a heb' winh sk'ayb'um ayik ayek' heb' winh t'a sti' ha' nhajab' Tiberias. Icha tik ix aj sch'oxan sb'a t'a heb' winh.

Ayek' winhaj Simón Pedro yet' winhaj Tomás tz'alji Tioxal. Ajun pax winhaj Natanael aj Caná t'a yol yik Galilea. Hanhejtona', ayek' pax heb' winh yuninal winhaj Zebedeo yet' chawanhxo heb' winh yetk'ayb'umal heb' winh.

Haxo winhaj Simón Pedro ix halan t'a heb' winh: --Ol in b'at yamoj chay, xchi winh t'a heb' winh. --Ol onh b'at het'ok, xchi heb' winh t'a winh. Yuj chi' ix b'at heb' winh. Ix och heb' winh t'a yol jun te' barco. Palta ha t'a jun ak'wal chi', malaj junok nok' ix yamchaj yuj heb' winh.
Haxo yik wanxo sakb'i, ayek' Jesús t'a sti' ha' chi'. Ha heb' winh sk'ayb'um chi' maj snalaj heb' winh tato ha'.
Ix yalankot t'a heb' winh: --Ex wetanima'il, ¿ay am nok' ix eyik'a'? xchi t'a heb' winh. --Ma'ay. Malaj nok', xchi heb' winh t'ay.

--Hak'ekem ch'anh he chimpa chi' t'a swach' te' barco chi', hata' ol yamchaj nok' eyu'uj, xchi t'a heb' winh. Ix yak'anem ch'anh heb' winh. Ix yak'lan heb' winh stok'ank'eta ch'anh, majxo yal-laj sk'eta ch'anh yuj yalil nok', yujto te tzijtum nok'.

Haxo jun winh sk'ayb'um Jesús te xajan yuj, a winh ix halan t'a winhaj Pedro chi': --Ina'i, a Kajal Jesús ayek' chi', xchi winh. Ix lajwinhej yab'an chi' winhaj Simón Pedro chi', ix yak'anoch spichul winh, yujto anhej yol spichul winh ayochi. Ix syumanelta sb'a winh t'a yol te' barco chi', ix elk'och winh t'a sti' ha'.

Ay am chanhe'ok ch'anhil ayb'at heb' winh t'a sat ha'. Haxo juntzanhxo heb' winh yetk'ayb'umal heb' winh, tzak'anto ix k'och heb' winh yet' jun yune' barco, nherb'il ch'anh chimpa b'ut'an yuj nok' chay chi' yuj heb' winh.
Haxo ix elta heb' winh, ix yilan heb' winh, ayoch jun k'ak' toxo ix el ichan. Wan sb'olan jun nok' chay Jesús chi'. Ay pax ek' juntzanh ixim pan t'a stz'ey.
Haxo ix yalan t'a heb' winh: --Ik'ekkot jaywanhok nok' he chay ix he yam chi', xchi.

Yuj chi' ix ochxi winhaj Simón Pedro t'a yol te' barco chi'. Ix stok'anelta ch'anh chimpa chi' winh t'a stak'inhal sti' ha'. Ix yilan heb' winh to b'ut'an ch'anh yuj juntzanh nok' niwak chay chi'. 153 sb'isul nok' smasanil. Palta wach'chom te al nok', maj t'inhchajlaj ch'anh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jesús t'a heb' winh: --Kotanhek, wa'anhek, xchi. Malaj junok heb' sk'ayb'um chi' ix k'anb'ani: ¿Mach ach? man xchiok heb' winh, yujto yojtakxo heb' winh to a Kajalil.
Ix snitzanoch sb'a Jesús t'a stz'ey heb' winh. Ix yik'ank'e ixim pan chi', ix spukanek' ixim t'a heb' winh. Hanhejtona' icha chi' ix yutej spukanek' nok' chay chi'.
Yoxelalxo sch'oxan sb'a Jesús t'a heb' sk'ayb'um chi' yiktax ix pitzwixi t'a skal heb' chamnak.

Ixlajwi swa heb', ix yalan Jesús t'a winhaj Simón Pedro: --Ach Simón yuninal winhaj Jonás, tzin k'anb'ej t'ayach, ¿más am tzin a xajanej t'a yichanh heb' winh tik? xchi t'a winh. --Yel ton Mamin. Ojtakxo to xajan ach wu'uj, xchi winhaj Pedro chi' t'ay. --Tato icha chi', icha junok tanhwum kalnel syak' wa nok' yunetak skalnel, icha chi' tzutej a k'ayb'an heb' wiko', xchi Jesús t'a winh.

Ix lajwinhej yalan juntzanh chi', ix yalanxi: --Ach Simón yuninal winhaj Jonás, ¿tzam in a xajanej? xchi t'a winh. --Yel ton Mamin. Ojtakxo to tzach in xajanej, xchixi winh. --Tato icha chi', icha junok tanhwum kalnel stanhwan nok' skalnel, icha chi' tzutej a tanhwan heb' wikxo, xchi Jesús chi' t'a winh.

Ix yalanxi t'a yoxelal: --Ach Simón yuninal winhaj Jonás, ¿tzam in a xajanej? xchi t'a winh. Yuj chi' ix te kusk'e winhaj Pedro chi', yujto yoxelalxo sk'anb'an Jesús chi' t'a winh tato xajan yuj winh. Yuj chi' ix yalanxi winh: --Mamin, ojtakxo smasanil, ojtak to xajan ach wu'uj, xchi winh t'ay. --Tato icha chi', icha junok tanhwum kalnel syak' wa nok' skalnel, icha chi' tzutej a k'ayb'an heb' wikxo.

Wal yel swal t'ayach, ha t'a yik kelem achto, munil tza pich a b'a. Tzach b'eyek' b'aj ay a gana. Palta ayik ol ach ichamaxok, tonhej ol ak'el li'an a k'ab', ch'ok mach ol tzek'an a nanhal, ol ach ik'jokb'at b'aj max yal a k'o'ol, xchi Jesús t'a winhaj Pedro chi'.
Icha chi' yutejnak yalan yuj tas ol aj scham winhaj Pedro chi', yik ol sch'oxel winh to niwan yelk'och Dios. Ixlajwi chi', ix yalanxi t'a winh: --Ochanh tzak'an wu'uj, xchi t'a winh.

Haxo ix meltzajb'at k'elan winhaj Pedro chi' t'a spatik, ix yilan winh, a winh sk'ayb'um Jesús xajan yuj, tzak'anxo'och winh yuj heb'. Haton jun winh chi' ix em k'ojan t'a stz'ey Jesús ayik ix wa heb' junel, ayik ix sk'anb'an winh t'a Jesús chi': Mamin, ¿mach ol ach ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' chamel chi'? xchi winh t'ay.
Ayik ix yilan jun winh chi' winhaj Pedro, ix sk'anb'an winh t'a Jesús: --Mamin, xal jun winh sja tik, ¿tas ol ik'an scham winh? xchi winh t'ay.
Yuj chi' ix yalan Jesús chi' t'a winh: --Taxonhej in gana pitzanto winh ayik ol in jaxok, malaj ochi. Ha ach tik, ochanh tzak'an wu'uj, xchi t'a winh.

Yuj chi' ix el spekal t'a skal heb' yikxo Dios to manh ol cham jun winh sk'ayb'um Jesús chi'. Palta maj yal-laj Jesús tato manh ol cham winh, anhej ix yala': Taxonhej in gana pitzanto winh ayik ol in jaxok, malaj ochi, xchi.
Haton jun winh k'ayb'um tik syak' testigo'al sb'a t'a juntzanh tik, ix stz'ib'ejkan winh. Kojtak to te yel juntzanh ix stz'ib'ejkan winh tik.
Tzijtumto juntzanhxo tas ix sk'ulej Jesús. K'inalok tato ix tz'ib'chajkan t'a junjunal, tzin na'a to max yab'laj jun yol yib'anhk'inal tik yik smolchajkan juntzanh u'um b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkan chi'. Amén
